books.title: 活着
books.author: 余华
books.authorBg: 余华，中国当代著名作家，1960年生于浙江杭州。早年曾做过牙医，后进入文化馆工作并开始文学创作，以冷静克制的笔触著称。
books.intro: 《活着》讲述地主少爷福贵历经家道中落、战乱与政治运动，先后失去所有至亲，最终与一头老牛相伴的故事。小说以平实语言展现人在极端苦难中对活着的执着。该书被誉为中国当代文学的代表作之一，被译为多种语言并改编为同名电影。

books.title: 百年孤独
books.author: 加西亚·马尔克斯
books.authorBg: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯，哥伦比亚作家，1927年生，1982年获诺贝尔文学奖。他是拉丁美洲魔幻现实主义文学的代表人物。
books.intro: 《百年孤独》以布恩迪亚家族七代人的兴衰为主线，交织神话、传说与现实，描绘马孔多小镇的百年沧桑。作品开创了魔幻现实主义的经典范式。该书被公认为20世纪最重要的文学作品之一。

books.title: 思考快与慢
books.author: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼
books.authorBg: 丹尼尔·卡尼曼，以色列裔美国心理学家，1934年生，2002年获诺贝尔经济学奖。他是行为经济学与决策心理学领域的奠基者之一。
books.intro: 本书将人类思维分为直觉快速的系统和理性缓慢的系统，揭示认知偏差如何影响判断。卡尼曼基于数十年研究，系统阐述了启发式与偏见理论。该书是理解人类决策机制的经典之作。

books.title: 人类简史
books.author: 尤瓦尔·赫拉利
books.authorBg: 尤瓦尔·赫拉利，以色列历史学家，1976年生。耶路撒冷希伯来大学教授，研究宏观历史与未来趋势。
books.intro: 本书从认知革命、农业革命到科学革命，梳理智人如何成为地球的主宰。赫拉利探讨虚构故事如何凝聚大规模协作。该书是纵览人类命运的全球畅销通俗史作。

books.title: 小王子
books.author: 圣埃克苏佩里
books.authorBg: 圣埃克苏佩里，法国作家、飞行员，1900年生。其作品常融合飞行经历与人生哲思。
books.intro: 小说写飞行员在沙漠遇见来自外星球的小王子，听他游历各星球的故事。作者以童话隐喻爱、责任与童真。该书是世界范围内译本极多的文学经典。

books.author: 乔治·奥威尔
books.authorBg: 乔治·奥威尔，英国作家，1903年生。以政治寓言与社会批判著称。
books.intro: 小说描绘极权社会老大哥全方位监控，塑造温斯顿反抗又屈服的命运。书中双重思想、新话等概念深入人心。该书是反乌托邦文学的里程碑。

books.title: 被讨厌的勇气
books.author: 岸见一郎
books.authorBg: 岸见一郎，日本哲学家、心理学家，1956年生。专研阿德勒心理学，亦从事相关写作与演讲。
books.intro: 本书以青年与哲人的对话形式，阐释阿德勒的课题分离与共同体感觉。作者主张人唯有接纳被讨厌才能获得自由。该书是通俗心理学畅销读物。

books.title: 沉默的大多数
books.author: 王小波
books.authorBg: 王小波，中国当代作家，1952年生。以杂文与小说《黄金时代》等著称，文风幽默犀利。
books.intro: 本书是王小波的杂文随笔集，针砭时弊、倡导理性与独立思考。他以幽默笔调谈文化、性与自由。该书是当代思想随笔的代表作。

books.title: 三体
books.author: 刘慈欣
books.authorBg: 刘慈欣，中国科幻作家，1963年生，高级工程师。他以三体系列开创中国科幻文学新高度，获雨果奖。
books.intro: 《三体》讲述地球文明与三体文明接触后引发的危机，融合物理学、历史与哲学想象。小说以黑暗森林理论叩问宇宙文明关系。该作获2015年雨果奖最佳长篇小说。

books.title: 解忧杂货店
books.author: 东野圭吾
books.authorBg: 东野圭吾，日本推理小说作家，1958年生。代表作有《白夜行》《嫌疑人X的献身》等，以精巧叙事著称。
books.intro: 小说围绕一家能跨越时空回信的神奇杂货店，串起多个陌生人相互慰藉的故事。东野以温情笔触写出人与人的羁绊。本书突破其惯常推理框架，展现柔软一面。

books.title: 平凡的世界
books.author: 路遥
books.authorBg: 路遥，原名王卫国，中国当代作家，1949年生。代表作《平凡的世界》获茅盾文学奖。
books.intro: 小说以陕北双水村孙少安、孙少平兄弟的奋斗为主线，展现改革开放前后普通人的命运。作品讴歌平凡人在苦难中的坚韧与尊严。该书被誉为激励一代人的现实主义力作。

books.title: 围城
books.author: 钱锺书
books.authorBg: 钱锺书，中国现代学者、作家，1910年生。学贯中西，著有《管锥编》等学术巨著。
books.intro: 《围城》以留学生方鸿渐的婚恋与职场经历为线索，讽刺抗战时期知识分子的众生相。名句城外的人想冲进去，城里的人想逃出来广为流传。小说语言幽默犀利，是现代讽刺文学经典。

books.title: 万历十五年
books.author: 黄仁宇
books.authorBg: 黄仁宇，美籍华裔历史学家，1918年生。提出大历史观，著有《中国大历史》等。
books.intro: 本书以1587年这一看似平淡的年份为切面，剖析明朝制度积弊与衰败根源。黄仁宇以宏观视角重写明代政治史。该书是通俗读史与学术结合的典范。

books.title: 枪炮、病菌与钢铁
books.author: 贾雷德·戴蒙德
books.authorBg: 贾雷德·戴蒙德，美国生理学家、地理学家，1937年生。加州大学洛杉矶分校教授，跨学科研究大家。
books.intro: 本书探讨为何欧亚文明而非其他大陆率先征服世界，归因于地理与生物资源差异。戴蒙德以演化生物学解释人类历史格局。该书获普利策奖，是宏观历史的代表作。

books.title: 穷查理宝典
books.author: 查理·芒格
books.authorBg: 查理·芒格，美国投资家，1924年生，伯克希尔·哈撒韦公司副主席。他是沃伦·巴菲特的长期合伙人。
books.intro: 本书汇编芒格的演讲与箴言，倡导多元思维模型与理性决策。他强调避免愚蠢比追求聪明更重要。该书是投资与思维方法的经典读物。

books.title: 原则
books.author: 瑞·达利欧
books.authorBg: 瑞·达利欧，美国投资家，桥水基金创始人，1949年生。其对冲基金管理规模居全球前列。
books.intro: 达利欧总结数十年管理与投资经验，提出以极度求真、极度透明为核心的行事原则。书中系统阐述个人与组织进化的方法。该书是管理与自我提升的畅销之作。

books.title: 乌合之众
books.author: 古斯塔夫·勒庞
books.authorBg: 古斯塔夫·勒庞，法国社会心理学家，1841年生。群体心理学研究的先驱之一。
books.intro: 本书分析群体心理特征，指出现代社会中个人融入群体后理性减弱、易受影响。勒庞的论断深刻影响了政治学与社会学。该书是理解大众行为与舆论的经典。

books.title: 自控力
books.author: 凯利·麦格尼格尔
books.authorBg: 凯利·麦格尼格尔，美国健康心理学家，斯坦福大学讲师。她开设的意志力科学课程广受欢迎。
books.intro: 本书基于心理学与神经科学，解析意志力的运作机制与消耗规律。作者提供可操作的训练方法来改善拖延与冲动。该书是通俗心理自助的畅销书。

books.title: 明朝那些事儿
books.author: 当年明月
books.authorBg: 当年明月，本名石悦，中国作家，1979年生。他以网络连载《明朝那些事儿》成名。
books.intro: 本书以通俗幽默的笔法重述明朝三百年历史，从朱元璋到崇祯娓娓道来。作品将严肃史学与大众阅读结合。该书长期位居历史类畅销书前列。

books.title: 追风筝的人
books.author: 卡勒德·胡赛尼
books.authorBg: 卡勒德·胡赛尼，阿富汗裔美国作家，1965年生。曾任医师，后专注写作。
books.intro: 小说以阿富汗动荡历史为背景，写少年阿米尔与仆人哈桑的友谊与背叛。赎罪的主题贯穿全书，情感深沉。该书是全球畅销的当代文学之作。

books.title: 挪威的森林
books.author: 村上春树
books.authorBg: 村上春树，日本作家，1949年生。作品融合西方现代派与日本质感，享誉世界文坛。
books.intro: 小说以主人公渡边回忆青春恋情，交织生与死、孤独与失去。村上以舒缓笔调写尽都市青年的迷惘。该书是其在华最具影响力的代表作之一。

books.title: 霍乱时期的爱情
books.author: 加西亚·马尔克斯
books.authorBg: 加夫列尔·加西亚·马尔克斯，哥伦比亚作家，1927年生，1982年诺贝尔文学奖得主。魔幻现实主义代表。
books.intro: 小说写弗洛伦蒂诺等待五十余年，终与年少恋人费尔米娜重续前缘。马尔克斯以绵长笔触写尽爱情的各种面貌。该书被誉为最动人的爱情长篇之一。

books.title: 老人与海
books.author: 欧内斯特·海明威
books.authorBg: 欧内斯特·海明威，美国小说家，1899年生。1954年获诺贝尔文学奖，冰山理论倡导者。
books.intro: 小说写老渔夫圣地亚哥远海捕巨鱼，归途与鲨鱼搏斗终仅剩骨架。海明威以极简笔法彰显人可以被毁灭，不能被打败。该书是其代表作之一。

books.title: 了不起的盖茨比
books.author: F·斯科特·菲茨杰拉德
books.authorBg: 菲茨杰拉德，美国小说家，爵士时代的代表作家，1896年生。
books.intro: 小说以叙述者尼克的视角，写富豪盖茨比对旧爱黛西的执念与幻灭。作品揭示美国梦的虚妄与阶层鸿沟。该书被誉为20世纪美国文学经典。

books.title: 悲惨世界
books.author: 维克多·雨果
books.authorBg: 维克多·雨果，法国浪漫主义文学巨匠，1802年生。代表作有《巴黎圣母院》等。
books.intro: 小说围绕苦役犯冉·阿让的救赎展开，铺陈19世纪法国社会画卷。雨果借此控诉贫困与法律的不公。该书是世界文学中篇幅宏大、影响深远的杰作。

books.title: 战争与和平
books.author: 列夫·托尔斯泰
books.authorBg: 列夫·托尔斯泰，俄国现实主义文学大师，1828年生。代表作还有《安娜·卡列尼娜》。
books.intro: 小说以拿破仑战争为背景，写俄罗斯贵族家庭的命运交织。托尔斯泰在宏大中探讨历史、自由与人生意义。该书被公认为世界长篇小说的巅峰之一。

books.title: 乡土中国
books.author: 费孝通
books.authorBg: 费孝通，中国社会学家、人类学家，1910年生。中国社会学和人类学的奠基人之一。
books.intro: 本书由系列文章构成，提出差序格局、礼治秩序等概念解析中国传统乡村社会。费孝通以田野调查为基础建构本土社会学理论。该书是理解中国基层社会的经典。

books.title: 美的历程
books.author: 李泽厚
books.authorBg: 李泽厚，中国哲学家、美学家，1930年生。在美学与思想史领域建树卓著。
books.intro: 本书以历史脉络梳理中国审美意识从甲骨纹饰到明清文艺的演变。李泽厚以哲学视角贯通艺术、文化与精神。该书是简明而深刻的中国美学史读本。

books.title: 时间简史
books.author: 史蒂芬·霍金
books.authorBg: 史蒂芬·霍金，英国理论物理学家，1942年生。剑桥大学教授，研究黑洞与宇宙学。
books.intro: 本书向大众讲解宇宙起源、黑洞、时间箭头与统一理论。霍金以通俗语言呈现前沿物理学图景。该书是全球畅销的科普经典。

books.title: 自私的基因
books.author: 理查德·道金斯
books.authorBg: 理查德·道金斯，英国进化生物学家，1941年生。牛津大学教授，科普写作名家。
books.intro: 本书提出基因是演化的基本单位，生物不过是基因的生存机器。道金斯以清晰逻辑阐释利他和利他行为的基因基础。该书是进化论科普的里程碑之作。

books.title: 物种起源
books.author: 查尔斯·达尔文
books.authorBg: 查尔斯·达尔文，英国博物学家，1809年生。进化论的奠基人。
books.intro: 本书系统提出以自然选择为核心的生物进化理论，颠覆神创论。达尔文以大量考察证据论证物种的亲缘与变迁。该书是现代生物学的基石文献。

books.title: 红楼梦
books.author: 曹雪芹
books.authorBg: 曹雪芹，清代小说家，约1715年生。出身江宁织造世家，晚年贫居北京西郊。
books.intro: 小说以贾宝玉、林黛玉、薛宝钗的爱情悲剧为轴线，写贾府由盛转衰。作品人物众多、结构恢宏，是中国古典小说巅峰。该书与另外三部并称为中国古典四大名著。

books.title: 三国演义
books.author: 罗贯中
books.authorBg: 罗贯中，元末明初小说家，约1330年生。相传为《三国演义》主要编撰者。
books.intro: 小说以三国鼎立的历史为背景，写魏蜀吴群雄争霸。书中塑造了诸葛亮、曹操等大批鲜活人物。该书是中国第一部章回体历史演义小说。

books.title: 水浒传
books.author: 施耐庵
books.authorBg: 施耐庵，元末明初小说家，约1296年生。一般被认为是《水浒传》的作者。
books.intro: 小说写北宋末年一百零八位好汉聚义梁山、替天行道的故事。作品歌颂反抗精神，也流露招安的悲剧。该书是中国英雄传奇小说的开山之作。

books.title: 西游记
books.author: 吴承恩
books.authorBg: 吴承恩，明代小说家，约1500年生。以神魔小说《西游记》著称。
books.intro: 小说写唐僧师徒西天取经，沿途降妖伏魔的奇幻历程。作品融合佛道思想与民间想象，讽刺世相。该书是中国神魔小说的经典代表。

books.title: 简爱
books.author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
books.authorBg: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特，英国女作家，1816年生。勃朗特三姐妹之一。
books.intro: 小说以孤女简爱的自述，写其追求平等尊严与真挚爱情的成长。作品彰显女性独立意识，突破时代局限。该书是英国文学中现实主义与女性书写的经典。

books.title: 傲慢与偏见
books.author: 简·奥斯汀
books.authorBg: 简·奥斯汀，英国女作家，1775年生。以婚恋与社会讽刺见长。
books.intro: 小说写伊丽莎白与达西从偏见误解到相知相爱的故事。奥斯汀以机智对白剖析阶层与婚姻。该书是英语文学中最受喜爱的爱情小说之一。

books.title: 麦田里的守望者
books.author: J.D.塞林格
books.authorBg: J.D.塞林格，美国作家，1919年生。以《麦田里的守望者》闻名于世。
books.intro: 小说以少年霍尔顿被开除后游荡纽约的几天为线索，宣泄对成人世界的疏离与反抗。塞林格写出青春期的迷惘与纯真。该书成为青少年反叛文化的符号。

books.title: 局外人
books.author: 阿尔贝·加缪
books.authorBg: 阿尔贝·加缪，法国作家、哲学家，1913年生。1957年获诺贝尔文学奖，荒诞哲学代表。
books.intro: 小说写小职员默尔索对母亲之死漠然，后因偶然杀人被判死刑。加缪以疏离笔调揭示世界的荒诞与个体的异己。该书是存在主义文学的代表作。

books.title: 鼠疫
books.author: 阿尔贝·加缪
books.authorBg: 阿尔贝·加缪，法国作家、哲学家，1913年生。1957年获诺贝尔文学奖，荒诞哲学代表。
books.intro: 小说以奥兰城突发鼠疫为背景，写医生里厄与市民们共同抗争瘟疫。加缪借此隐喻法西斯占领与人性的坚韧。该书是存在主义反抗精神的经典寓言。

books.title: 穷爸爸富爸爸
books.author: 罗伯特·清崎
books.authorBg: 罗伯特·清崎，美国企业家、投资教育家，1947年生。以财商教育系列读物闻名。
books.intro: 本书通过穷爸爸与富爸爸两种金钱观的对比，讲资产与负债的区别。清崎强调财商教育对财务自由的重要。该书是全球畅销的理财启蒙书。

books.title: 影响力
books.author: 罗伯特·西奥迪尼
books.authorBg: 罗伯特·西奥迪尼，美国社会心理学家，1945年生。亚利桑那州立大学荣休教授。
books.intro: 本书归纳互惠、承诺一致、社会认同等六大说服原则，解析人为何会顺从。西奥迪尼以实验与社会实例阐明影响力的机制。该书是营销与心理学的经典读物。

books.title: 卓有成效的管理者
books.author: 彼得·德鲁克
books.authorBg: 彼得·德鲁克，奥地利裔美国管理学家，1909年生。被尊为现代管理学之父。
books.intro: 本书面向知识工作者，提出管理时间、重视贡献、用人之长等实效原则。德鲁克强调成效而非忙碌。该书是管理学的奠基性通俗著作。

books.title: 看见
books.author: 柴静
books.authorBg: 柴静，中国记者、主持人，1976年生。曾任央视《新闻调查》等栏目记者。
books.intro: 本书是柴静十年记者生涯的自述，记录非典、汶川地震等事件的采访亲历。她以个人视角反思新闻与真实。该书是引发广泛关注的纪实作品。

books.title: 目送
books.author: 龙应台
books.authorBg: 龙应台，中国台湾作家，1952年生。以《野火集》等杂文闻名，亦擅亲情书写。
books.intro: 本书是龙应台写给父亲、母亲与儿子的散文集，写亲情中的目送与别离。文字温柔克制，叩问生死与牵挂。该书是当代华文散文的畅销之作。

books.title: 撒哈拉的故事
books.author: 三毛
books.authorBg: 三毛，本名陈平，中国台湾作家，1943年生。以率性洒脱的游记散文著称。
books.intro: 本书记录三毛与丈夫荷西在撒哈拉沙漠的生活点滴，写异域风土与质朴人情。文字自由灵动，充满浪漫气息。该书是华语游记文学的经典。

books.title: 我们仨
books.author: 杨绛
books.authorBg: 杨绛，中国作家、翻译家，1911年生。钱锺书之妻，译有《堂吉诃德》等。
books.intro: 本书是杨绛回忆与丈夫钱锺书、女儿钱瑗的家庭生活。在温婉叙述中，写尽聚散离合与思念。该书是晚年追忆亲人的至情之作。

books.title: 白夜行
books.author: 东野圭吾
books.authorBg: 东野圭吾，日本推理小说作家，1958年生。代表作有《白夜行》《嫌疑人X的献身》等。
books.intro: 小说写少年亮司与雪穗因一桩命案命运纠缠，在黑暗中相互依存地长大。东野以冷峻笔触铺陈跨越十九年的罪恶与守护。该书是其推理悬疑的巅峰作之一。

books.title: 恶意
books.author: 东野圭吾
books.authorBg: 东野圭吾，日本推理小说作家，1958年生。以本格与社会派推理见长。
books.intro: 小说写畅销作家被害，凶手迅速落网，动机却扑朔迷离。东野反转常规，探讨人心深处无端的恶意。该书以动机之谜著称。

books.title: 未来简史
books.author: 尤瓦尔·赫拉利
books.authorBg: 尤瓦尔·赫拉利，以色列历史学家，1976年生。耶路撒冷希伯来大学教授。
books.intro: 本书继《人类简史》后，展望未来人类面临算法、数据与新挑战的命运。赫拉利探讨智人之后谁将主宰。该书是思考科技与人类命运的畅销之作。

shorts.title: 背影
shorts.author: 朱自清
shorts.intro: 《背影》写父亲送别儿子北上求学，在火车站翻越月台为儿子买橘子的情景。文中父亲蹒跚的背影成为现代散文中的经典意象，抒发深沉父爱。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 荷塘月色
shorts.author: 朱自清
shorts.intro: 本文写作者夏夜漫步清华园荷塘的所见所感，以细腻笔触描绘月下荷塘的幽静之美。文章流露出现实烦扰中寻求片刻宁静的心境。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 故乡
shorts.author: 鲁迅
shorts.intro: 小说以我回故乡迁居的见闻为线索，刻画了闰土由活泼少年变为麻木中年人的变化。作品表达了对旧中国社会现实的深沉忧思。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 孔乙己
shorts.author: 鲁迅
shorts.intro: 小说通过咸亨酒店小伙计的视角，塑造了深受科举制度毒害、穷困潦倒的孔乙己形象。结尾孔乙己长久未出现，留下意味深长的空白。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 阿长与山海经
shorts.author: 鲁迅
shorts.intro: 本文回忆童年保姆长妈妈，写她粗俗却善良，不识字的她为我买来渴求已久的《山海经》。文章饱含对底层劳动妇女的温情敬意。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 边城（节选）
shorts.author: 沈从文
shorts.intro: 《边城》以湘西茶峒小镇为背景，讲述船家少女翠翠与傩送之间纯真而怅惘的爱情。节选呈现了小镇风土人情与人物微妙情感。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 项脊轩志
shorts.author: 归有光
shorts.intro: 明代散文名篇，作者借老屋项脊轩的兴废，追忆母亲、祖母与妻子等亲人。全文以日常琐事寄寓深长亲情，情真意切。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 我与地坛
shorts.author: 史铁生
shorts.intro: 史铁生以残疾后常去的地坛为线索，思索生命、命运与母亲的爱。作品在沉静中透出对存在的豁达与坚韧。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 秋天的怀念
shorts.author: 史铁生
shorts.intro: 文章回忆双腿瘫痪后母亲默默呵护、渴望带我看菊花的往事。母亲病逝后，作者才读懂那份隐忍而深沉的爱。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 端午的鸭蛋
shorts.author: 汪曾祺
shorts.intro: 汪曾祺以故乡高邮的端午习俗与鸭蛋为题，写尽生活情趣与乡愁。文字平淡自然，充满人间烟火气。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 济南的冬天
shorts.author: 老舍
shorts.intro: 老舍描绘济南冬天温晴无风、山水如画的独特景致。行文清新亲切，展现对第二故乡的喜爱。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 小桔灯
shorts.author: 冰心
shorts.intro: 散文写抗战时期作者在山城遇见的贫苦小女孩，她制作小桔灯送别客人。微弱灯光象征困境中的希望与温暖。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 乡愁
shorts.author: 余光中
shorts.intro: 余光中以邮票、船票、坟墓、海峡等意象，写尽对故乡与大陆的绵长思念。诗句凝练，是当代怀乡诗的经典。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 故都的秋
shorts.author: 郁达夫
shorts.intro: 郁达夫写北平秋天清静悲凉的韵味，从胡同秋雨到庭院落蕊，细致入微。文章寄托了乱世中淡淡的孤寂与眷恋。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 竹影
shorts.author: 丰子恺
shorts.intro: 本文写孩子们月下看竹影、描画游戏的童年趣事，由画引出对中国画意趣的启蒙。文风朴实温馨，富童真之美。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 雅舍
shorts.author: 梁实秋
shorts.intro: 梁实秋记述抗战时期在重庆简陋的居所雅舍，于清苦中品评生活雅趣。文章幽默旷达，彰显文人随遇而安的从容。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 桃花心木
shorts.author: 林清玄
shorts.intro: 林清玄由种树人刻意不定时浇桃花心木，悟出人须在不确定中学会自立。文短意深，富含人生哲理。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 紫藤萝瀑布
shorts.author: 宗璞
shorts.intro: 作者面对盛开的紫藤萝，由花儿的兴衰联想到生命的长河无止息。文章在美的描写中传递豁达的生命感悟。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 提醒幸福
shorts.author: 毕淑敏
shorts.intro: 毕淑敏提醒人们幸福常被忽视，需主动去感受与珍惜当下。文章以平实话语探讨幸福的平常与珍贵。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 哦，香雪
shorts.author: 铁凝
shorts.intro: 小说写北方山村少女香雪偶然搭上火车，用鸡蛋换回一只铅笔盒的故事。作品刻画了少女对文明与未来的纯真向往。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 棋王（节选）
shorts.author: 阿城
shorts.intro: 《棋王》以知青岁月为背景，刻画痴迷象棋的少年王一生。节选展现其棋道即人道的执着与淡泊。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 呼兰河传（节选）
shorts.author: 萧红
shorts.intro: 萧红以童年视角回忆东北小城呼兰河的风土与人事。节选充满对祖父与后园的温柔怀念，笔调凄美。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 稻草人
shorts.author: 叶圣陶
shorts.intro: 叶圣陶童话名篇，写田间稻草人目睹农妇、渔妇的苦难却无力相助。作品以童话形式关怀底层民众的悲苦。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 春
shorts.author: 朱自清
shorts.intro: 朱自清以清新笔触描绘春天到来时草木萌发、生机盎然的景象。文章节奏明快，是描写春景的典范散文。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 麦琪的礼物
shorts.author: 欧·亨利
shorts.intro: 欧·亨利写一对贫苦夫妻在圣诞前夕互赠礼物，却都卖掉了对方所赠礼物依赖的东西。结尾出人意料，歌颂无私之爱。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 最后一片叶子
shorts.author: 欧·亨利
shorts.intro: 病重女孩坚信窗外最后一片藤叶落下自己便将死去，老画家冒雨画下一片常青的叶子。作品讴歌平凡人的牺牲与善意。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 项链
shorts.author: 莫泊桑
shorts.intro: 莫泊桑写小职员妻子为舞会借项链，丢失后辛苦十年偿还，却发现原是假货。小说讽刺虚荣，结局令人唏嘘。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 羊脂球
shorts.author: 莫泊桑
shorts.intro: 小说以普法战争为背景，写妓女羊脂球与被困同行的上层人士的对照。莫泊桑借此揭露所谓上流社会的虚伪与自私。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 变色龙
shorts.author: 契诃夫
shorts.intro: 契诃夫塑造了见风使舵的警官，其态度随狗主人身份反复变化。作品是讽刺趋炎附势的经典短篇。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 套中人
shorts.author: 契诃夫
shorts.intro: 小说写极端保守、凡事裹在套子里的别里科夫，他的存在令全城窒息。契诃夫借此批判因循守旧的社会心理。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 变形记
shorts.author: 卡夫卡
shorts.intro: 卡夫卡写旅行推销员格里高尔某晨醒来变成甲虫，遭家人逐渐疏离。作品以荒诞揭示现代人的异化与孤独。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 百万英镑
shorts.author: 马克·吐温
shorts.intro: 马克·吐温写一穷汉获赠一张无法兑现的百万英镑钞，竟因之备受追捧。小说讽刺金钱至上的世态人心。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 最后一课
shorts.author: 都德
shorts.intro: 都德以普法战争为背景，写阿尔萨斯小镇最后一堂法语课的情景。小说抒发失去母语与国土的悲怆爱国之情。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 驿站长
shorts.author: 普希金
shorts.intro: 普希金以驿站长维林与女儿冬妮亚的离别写小人物的不幸。它是俄国文学中小人物题材的早期名篇。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 竹林中
shorts.author: 芥川龙之介
shorts.intro: 芥川以多视角叙述一桩竹林命案，各人供词互相矛盾。作品探讨真相的相对与人性的暧昧，后被改编为电影《罗生门》。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 雪国（节选）
shorts.author: 川端康成
shorts.intro: 川端康成写东京男子岛村与雪国艺伎驹子的邂逅。节选以空灵笔触描摹雪国风情与淡淡哀愁，是其获诺贝尔文学奖的代表作之一。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 乞力马扎罗的雪
shorts.author: 海明威
shorts.intro: 海明威写作家哈里濒死时于非洲草原回顾一生，在雪山意象中直面虚无。作品以冰山风格呈现生死思索。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 献给艾米丽的一朵玫瑰花
shorts.author: 福克纳
shorts.intro: 福克纳写南方小镇老处女艾米丽拒绝时间流逝、固守旧秩序的孤绝一生。小说意象阴郁，充满南方哥特气息。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 快乐王子
shorts.author: 王尔德
shorts.intro: 王尔德童话写快乐王子雕像倾尽身上珍宝帮助穷人，最终被弃。作品以唯美故事寄寓对苦难与奉献的关怀。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 卖火柴的小女孩
shorts.author: 安徒生
shorts.intro: 安徒生写除夕夜卖火柴的小女孩在寒夜中划亮火柴，于幻象里见到温暖与祖母。童话揭露贫富悬殊，催人泪下。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 丑小鸭
shorts.author: 安徒生
shorts.intro: 安徒生写被歧视的丑小鸭历经磨难，终成美丽天鹅。童话以隐喻诉说成长、自我认同与内在价值。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 飞鸟集（选段）
shorts.author: 泰戈尔
shorts.intro: 泰戈尔《飞鸟集》以短小诗句录自然与哲思，如生如夏花之绚烂。选段展现诗人对生命与神性的静观。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 先知（选段）
shorts.author: 纪伯伦
shorts.intro: 纪伯伦《先知》以智者临别赠言，谈爱、工作、自由等人生课题。选段蕴含东方智慧与诗意哲思。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 随笔集（选段）
shorts.author: 蒙田
shorts.intro: 蒙田被尊为随笔文体之父，其《随笔集》坦诚剖析自我与世相。选段体现怀疑精神与人文主义态度。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 论读书
shorts.author: 培根
shorts.intro: 培根短文论读书的功用与方法，名句读书足以怡情，足以傅彩，足以长才广为传诵。文约意丰，是英文论说文的典范。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 我为什么而活着
shorts.author: 罗素
shorts.intro: 罗素以简短文字概括驱使其一生的是对爱的渴望、对知识的追求、对人类苦难的同情。文章凝练，彰显哲人胸怀。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 记承天寺夜游
shorts.author: 苏轼
shorts.intro: 苏轼写被贬黄州夜不能眠，寻张怀民同游承天寺，赏月抒怀。短文寥寥数语，尽显旷达洒脱的心境。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 桃花源记
shorts.author: 陶渊明
shorts.intro: 陶渊明虚构武陵渔人偶入与世隔绝的桃花源，描绘和平安宁的理想社会。文章寄托对战乱现实的厌弃与对美好的向往。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 小石潭记
shorts.author: 柳宗元
shorts.intro: 柳宗元写探幽小石潭，状其清冽幽寂之景，亦暗寓贬谪孤寂之心。山水小品情景交融，为唐宋八家名作。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 岳阳楼记
shorts.author: 范仲淹
shorts.intro: 范仲淹借岳阳楼记抒先天下之忧而忧，后天下之乐而乐的襟怀。文章写景壮阔，立意高远。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 醉翁亭记
shorts.author: 欧阳修
shorts.intro: 欧阳修写滁州山水与与民同乐的宴游，名句醉翁之意不在酒流传至今。文风从容婉转，富有情趣。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 兰亭集序
shorts.author: 王羲之
shorts.intro: 王羲之记兰亭雅集修禊，饮酒赋诗，感生死聚散之无常。既是文学名篇，其书法亦被誉为天下第一行书。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 湖心亭看雪
shorts.author: 张岱
shorts.intro: 张岱写雪夜独往西湖湖心亭看雪，偶遇金陵人的清冷邂逅。小品淡远孤峭，寄托故国之思。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 满井游记
shorts.author: 袁宏道
shorts.intro: 袁宏道写城郊满井初春出游，捕捉解冻生机。文笔轻快，体现公安派独抒性灵的主张。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 瓦尔登湖（选段）
shorts.author: 梭罗
shorts.intro: 梭罗记独居瓦尔登湖畔两年，简朴生活中沉思自然与自我。选段倡导回归本真、审视生命的意义。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 老人与海（节选）
shorts.author: 海明威
shorts.intro: 海明威写老渔夫圣地亚哥远海钓巨鱼，与鲨鱼搏斗终仅剩骨架。节选彰显人可以被毁灭，不能被打败的硬汉精神。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 简爱（节选）
shorts.author: 夏洛蒂·勃朗特
shorts.intro: 勃朗特以孤女简爱的自述，写其追求平等与尊严的爱情。节选展现女主人公独立刚强的人格。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 小王子（节选）
shorts.author: 圣埃克苏佩里
shorts.intro: 圣埃克苏佩里借飞行员与小王子的星际旅程，探讨爱、责任与童真。选段以驯养之喻叩问人与人的联结。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 丛林之书（节选）
shorts.author: 吉卜林
shorts.intro: 吉卜林写被狼群抚养的孩童毛格利在丛林中的成长冒险。选段充满异域想象，蕴含自然与法则的启蒙。约10分钟可读完。

shorts.title: 再别康桥
shorts.author: 徐志摩
shorts.intro: 徐志摩以轻柔笔触写离别康桥的依依之情，云彩金柳意境优美。是新诗中的抒情名篇。约10分钟可读完。

long.en: Although the internet has brought unprecedented convenience, it has also given rise to concerns that personal privacy is being eroded at an alarming rate.
long.zh: 尽管互联网带来了前所未有的便利，但它也引发了人们对个人隐私正以惊人速度被侵蚀的担忧。
long.structure: 主句为'it has given rise to concerns'主谓宾结构；although引导让步状语从句前置；that引导同位语从句，解释concerns的具体内容。
long.idiom: 'give rise to'为正式书面搭配，意为'引起、导致'；'at an alarming rate'是地道表达，表示'以惊人的速度'，常用于描述负面趋势。

long.en: It is the government's responsibility, rather than that of private companies, to ensure that essential services are accessible to every citizen regardless of income.
long.zh: 确保每位公民无论收入高低都能获得基本服务，是政府的责任，而非私营公司的责任。
long.structure: 主干为'It is the government's responsibility to ensure...'；it作形式主语，真正主语是不定式；rather than表对比；that引导ensure的宾语从句；regardless of为让步状语。
long.idiom: 'rather than'表'而不是'，用于对比取舍；'regardless of'为固定短语，意为'不论、不管'，后接名词或动名词。

long.en: Had the committee taken the potential risks into account earlier, the catastrophic failure of the project could have been avoided.
long.zh: 如果委员会早些将潜在风险考虑在内，本可以避免项目的灾难性失败。
long.structure: 本句为虚拟语气的倒装结构，'Had the committee taken...'相当于'If the committee had taken...'；主句为'could have been avoided'的被动虚拟语气。
long.idiom: 'take sth into account'意为'把某事考虑在内'，是学术写作高频搭配；'catastrophic failure'为地道名词短语，指'灾难性失败'。

long.en: The extent to which automation will displace human labor depends largely on how swiftly workers can acquire new skills suited to a digital economy.
long.zh: 自动化在多大程度上取代人力，很大程度上取决于劳动者多快能掌握适应数字经济的新技能。
long.structure: 主句主干为'The extent depends on...'；to which引导定语从句修饰extent；depends on后接how引导的宾语从句；suited to作后置定语修饰skills。
long.idiom: 'to which'与extent搭配构成'在……程度上'；'suited to'意为'适合、适应'，是过去分词作定语的地道用法。

long.en: Not only does climate change threaten biodiversity, but it also exacerbates existing inequalities between developed and developing nations.
long.zh: 气候变化不仅威胁生物多样性，还加剧了发达国家与发展中国家之间原有的不平等。
long.structure: 'Not only'置于句首引起部分倒装，助动词does提前；but also连接并列分句；between...and...作inequalities的后置定语。
long.idiom: 'not only...but also...'为并列递进结构，注意前句需倒装；'exacerbate inequalities'是外刊常用搭配，意为'加剧不平等'。

long.en: What makes the new policy controversial is that it appears to prioritize economic growth over environmental protection, a trade-off many voters reject.
long.zh: 这项新政策引发争议的原因在于，它似乎把经济增长置于环境保护之上，而许多选民拒绝这种取舍。
long.structure: 主干为'What makes...is that...'主语从句+表语从句；that引导表语从句；a trade-off...为同位语，修饰前文取舍；many voters reject为省略that的定语从句。
long.idiom: 'prioritize A over B'是写作核心搭配，意为'把A置于B之上'；'trade-off'指'权衡、取舍'，为雅思高频词。

long.en: Given that renewable energy costs have fallen dramatically, there is little justification for delaying the transition away from fossil fuels.
long.zh: 鉴于可再生能源成本已大幅下降，拖延向非化石能源转型已无多少正当理由。
long.structure: 'Given that'引导原因状语从句；主句为'there is little justification for...'存在句；for delaying...为介词短语作定语修饰justification。
long.idiom: 'given that'意为'鉴于、考虑到'，引出已知前提；'there is little justification for'为正式表达，相当于'没有理由'。

long.en: The researcher argued that, far from being a neutral tool, artificial intelligence inevitably reflects the biases embedded in the data it is trained on.
long.zh: 研究者认为，人工智能远非中立工具，它不可避免地反映了训练数据本身所携带的偏见。
long.structure: 主句为'The researcher argued that...'；that引导宾语从句，其中'far from being...'为插入状语；embedded in...为过去分词作后置定语；it is trained on为定语从句修饰data。
long.idiom: 'far from being'意为'远非、绝不是'，用于强调反驳；'be trained on'是机器学习地道搭配，指'基于……训练'。

long.en: Unless stricter regulations are introduced, the gap between the wealthy and the poor is likely to widen beyond the point of social stability.
long.zh: 除非出台更严格的监管，否则贫富差距很可能扩大到危及社会稳定的程度。
long.structure: 'Unless'引导条件状语从句（相当于if not），用被动语态；主句为'the gap is likely to widen'；beyond...为介词短语作程度状语。
long.idiom: 'unless'意为'除非'，引导否定条件；'beyond the point of'为地道表达，意为'超出……的限度'。

long.en: What the report fails to mention is the fact that short-term profits often come at the expense of long-term sustainability.
long.zh: 报告未提及的事实是，短期利润往往是以长期可持续性为代价换来的。
long.structure: 主干为'What...is the fact that...'主语从句+表语（含同位语从句）；that引导同位语从句解释fact；at the expense of为介词短语作状语。
long.idiom: 'come at the expense of'是高频搭配，意为'以……为代价'；'short-term/long-term'对比结构常见于议论文。

long.en: So compelling was the evidence presented by the scientists that the committee had no choice but to revise its initial assessment.
long.zh: 科学家提交的证据如此有说服力，以至于委员会别无选择，只能修正其最初评估。
long.structure: 'So+形容词'置于句首引起主句部分倒装（was the evidence）；that引导结果状语从句；presented by...为过去分词作后置定语。
long.idiom: 'so...that...'表'如此……以至于'；倒装时so短语必须前置；'have no choice but to'意为'别无选择只能'。

long.en: While some economists maintain that inflation is transitory, others contend that it has become deeply entrenched in the labor market.
long.zh: 一些经济学家认为通胀是暂时的，另一些人则主张它已在劳动力市场根深蒂固。
long.structure: 'While'引导让步状语从句（意为'尽管'）；主句为'others contend that...'；that引导 contend的宾语从句，其中entrenched为过去分词作表语。
long.idiom: 'while'在此表对比/让步而非时间；'deeply entrenched'为地道搭配，指'根深蒂固'；'maintain/contend'为议论文替换动词。

long.en: The museum, which was founded in the nineteenth century, has recently launched a digital archive aimed at making its collection accessible worldwide.
long.zh: 这座成立于19世纪的博物馆，最近推出了一个数字档案库，旨在让全球都能访问其藏品。
long.structure: 主干为'The museum has launched a digital archive'；which引导非限制性定语从句修饰museum；aimed at...为过去分词作后置定语修饰archive。
long.idiom: 'aimed at doing'意为'旨在、目的是'；'make sth accessible'为'使……可获得'的固定搭配。

long.en: It was not until the leak was made public that the corporation acknowledged the severity of the environmental damage it had caused.
long.zh: 直到泄漏事件被公开，这家公司才承认其造成的环境破坏之严重。
long.structure: 'It was not until...that...'为强调句型，强调时间状语；that从句中the corporation作主语，acknowledged带宾语从句；it had caused为定语从句修饰damage。
long.idiom: 'not until'置于强调句，主句谓语不倒装但从句通常倒装；'acknowledge the severity'为正式书面搭配。

long.en: By shifting the tax burden from labor to carbon emissions, policymakers hope to simultaneously boost employment and curb greenhouse gases.
long.zh: 通过将税负从劳动力转向碳排放，决策者希望同时促进就业并遏制温室气体。
long.structure: 'By shifting...'为介词短语作方式状语，内含from...to...对比；主句为'policymakers hope to...'；to boost and curb为并列不定式作hope的宾语。
long.idiom: 'shift A from B to C'意为'把A从B转向C'；'curb greenhouse gases'是环境类写作高频搭配，指'遏制温室气体'。

long.en: The assumption that economic growth automatically translates into improved well-being has been called into question by recent studies.
long.zh: 经济增长会自动转化为民生改善这一假设，已受到近期研究的质疑。
long.structure: 主干为'The assumption has been called into question'被动语态；that引导同位语从句解释assumption；by recent studies为动作发出者。
long.idiom: 'translate into'意为'转化为'；'call sth into question'为正式搭配，指'对……提出质疑'。

long.en: Despite mounting evidence of its harms, the industry continues to lobby against legislation designed to protect vulnerable consumers.
long.zh: 尽管其危害的证据不断增加，该行业仍在游说反对旨在保护弱势消费者的立法。
long.structure: 'Despite mounting evidence...'为介词短语作让步状语；主句为'the industry continues to lobby against legislation'；designed to...为过去分词作后置定语。
long.idiom: 'mounting evidence'指'与日俱增的证据'；'lobby against'为政治/商业地道动词，意为'游说反对'。

long.en: Crucial to the success of any reform is the willingness of ordinary citizens to accept short-term sacrifices for long-term gains.
long.zh: 任何改革成功的关键在于普通民众愿为长期收益接受短期牺牲的意愿。
long.structure: 本句为完全倒装，表语'Crucial to the success'前置，主语为'the willingness...'；to accept...为不定式作后置定语修饰willingness。
long.idiom: 'crucial to'意为'对……至关重要'；'short-term sacrifices for long-term gains'是议论文经典对比表述。

long.en: Because the two studies adopted fundamentally different methodologies, their seemingly contradictory findings may in fact be complementary.
long.zh: 由于两项研究采用了根本不同的方法，它们看似矛盾的结论实际上可能互补。
long.structure: 'Because'引导原因状语从句；主句为'their findings may be complementary'；seemingly contradictory为前置修饰；in fact为副词插入语。
long.idiom: 'adopt methodologies'意为'采用方法'；'seemingly contradictory'指'看似矛盾'；'in fact'表'实际上'转折。

long.en: The city's decision to ban single-use plastics, though initially unpopular, has proven effective in reducing ocean pollution.
long.zh: 该市禁用一次性塑料的决定，尽管起初不受欢迎，但已被证明能有效减少海洋污染。
long.structure: 主干为'The city's decision has proven effective'；to ban...为不定式作后置定语；though initially unpopular为省略be的让步状语。
long.idiom: 'single-use plastics'指'一次性塑料'；'prove effective in'为'被证明在……有效'的正式表达。

long.en: Were it not for the subsidies provided by the state, many clean-energy startups would have struggled to survive their first year.
long.zh: 若非国家提供补贴，许多清洁能源初创企业恐怕难以撑过第一年。
long.structure: 'Were it not for...'为虚拟条件句的倒装（相当于If it were not for）；主句为'would have struggled'对过去的虚拟；provided by...作后置定语。
long.idiom: 'were it not for'意为'若不是因为'；'struggle to survive'为'艰难生存'的常用搭配。

long.en: What distinguishes the most resilient societies is not the absence of crises but their capacity to learn and adapt in their aftermath.
long.zh: 最具韧性社会的不同之处，不在于没有危机，而在于其在危机后学习与适应的能力。
long.structure: 主干为'What distinguishes...is not...but...'主语从句+并列表语；absence of crises与capacity to...形成对比；in their aftermath为时间状语。
long.idiom: 'not A but B'表'不是A而是B'；'in the aftermath'意为'在……之后（尤指灾难后）'。

long.en: The professor's lecture, delivered entirely without notes, left the audience with a profound appreciation of the subject's complexity.
long.zh: 教授完全脱稿的演讲，让听众深刻体会到该学科的复杂性。
long.structure: 主干为'The professor's lecture left the audience with...'；delivered entirely without notes为过去分词作后置定语；with a profound appreciation为伴随状语。
long.idiom: 'without notes'指'脱稿、无讲稿'；'leave sb with'意为'给某人留下（某种感受）'。

long.en: If the trend continues, experts warn, the number of species at risk of extinction could triple within the next few decades.
long.zh: 专家警告，若趋势持续，面临灭绝风险的物种数量在未来几十年内可能增至三倍。
long.structure: 主句为'experts warn'插入语；if引导条件状语从句；the number...could triple为主句，at risk of...作后置定语，within...为时间状语。
long.idiom: 'at risk of'意为'面临……风险'；'within the next few decades'是预测类写作常见时间表述。

long.en: Under no circumstances should personal data be sold to third parties without the explicit consent of the individual concerned.
long.zh: 在任何情况下，都不得在未获相关个人明确同意的情况下将其数据出售给第三方。
long.structure: 'Under no circumstances'否定状语前置引起主句部分倒装（should personal data be sold）；without...为条件状语；concerned为后置定语修饰individual。
long.idiom: 'under no circumstances'意为'在任何情况下都不'，必须引起倒装；'explicit consent'指'明确同意'。

long.en: The fact that remote work has reshaped employee expectations presents a challenge that traditional managers are ill-equipped to handle.
long.zh: 远程办公重塑了员工预期这一事实，给传统管理者带来了他们难以应对的挑战。
long.structure: 主干为'The fact presents a challenge'；that引导同位语从句解释fact；that traditional managers...为定语从句修饰challenge；ill-equipped为表语。
long.idiom: 'ill-equipped to'意为'不具备……能力/条件'；'reshape expectations'指'重塑预期'。

long.en: Only by investing heavily in public transport can cities hope to alleviate the congestion that plagues their centers during rush hour.
long.zh: 只有大力投资公共交通，城市才有希望缓解高峰时段困扰市中心的拥堵。
long.structure: 'Only by...'介词短语前置引起主句部分倒装（can cities hope）；to alleviate...为目的状语；that plagues...为定语从句修饰congestion。
long.idiom: 'only by'前置须倒装；'rush hour'指'高峰时段'；'plague'作动词意为'困扰、折磨'。

long.en: Whereas previous generations prized job security, younger workers increasingly value flexibility and a sense of purpose.
long.zh: 相比前几代人看重工作稳定，年轻劳动者越来越重视灵活性与目标感。
long.structure: 'Whereas'引导对比状语从句；主句为'younger workers value flexibility and a sense of purpose'；increasingly为副词修饰value。
long.idiom: 'prize'作动词意为'珍视'；'a sense of purpose'指'目标感、意义感'，为口语与写作通用表达。

long.en: The committee recommended that the proposal be implemented immediately, irrespective of the objections raised by minority stakeholders.
long.zh: 委员会建议立即实施方案，而不管少数股东提出的反对意见。
long.structure: 主句为'The committee recommended that...'；that从句用虚拟语气（be implemented，省略should）；irrespective of...为让步状语；raised by...作后置定语。
long.idiom: 'recommend that...be'用虚拟语气；'irrespective of'意为'不论、不顾'；'minority stakeholders'指'少数股东'。

long.en: Having exhausted all conventional treatments, the patient opted for an experimental therapy that had shown promise in early trials.
long.zh: 在用尽所有常规疗法后，该患者选择了在早期试验中显现前景的实验性治疗。
long.structure: 'Having exhausted...'为现在分词完成式作时间状语；主句为'the patient opted for a therapy'；that had shown...为定语从句修饰therapy。
long.idiom: 'exhaust all options/treatments'意为'用尽所有办法'；'show promise'指'显现前景/希望'。

long.en: The degree to which a society protects its weakest members is, many would argue, the truest measure of its civilization.
long.zh: 一个社会保护其最弱势成员的程度，许多人会认为，是其文明最真实的衡量标准。
long.structure: 主干为'The degree is the truest measure'；to which引导定语从句修饰degree；many would argue为插入语；of its civilization为后置定语。
long.idiom: 'the truest measure of'意为'……最真实的衡量'；插入语'many would argue'增强论述客观性。

long.en: Notwithstanding the optimistic forecasts, consumer confidence remains fragile, owing largely to persistent uncertainty in the job market.
long.zh: 尽管预测乐观，消费者信心依旧脆弱，主要源于就业市场持续的不确定性。
long.structure: 'Notwithstanding the forecasts'为介词短语作让步状语；主句为'consumer confidence remains fragile'；owing largely to...为原因状语。
long.idiom: 'notwithstanding'为正式'尽管'；'owing to'表原因；'consumer confidence'是经济类高频术语。

long.en: The documentary illustrates how, in the absence of strict oversight, corporate greed can precipitate a cascade of failures.
long.zh: 这部纪录片展示了，在缺乏严格监管的情况下，企业贪婪如何引发一连串的失败。
long.structure: 主干为'The documentary illustrates how...'；how引导宾语从句，其中'in the absence of...'为条件状语；precipitate带宾语a cascade of failures。
long.idiom: 'in the absence of'意为'在缺乏……的情况下'；'precipitate'作动词指'引发、加速（坏事）'；'a cascade of'指'一连串'。

long.en: Should the negotiations fail to produce an agreement, both sides stand to lose far more than they might anticipate.
long.zh: 若谈判未能达成协议，双方损失将远超预期。
long.structure: 'Should the negotiations fail...'为虚拟条件句倒装（相当于If...should fail）；主句为'both sides stand to lose'；more than...为比较状语。
long.idiom: 'should'虚拟倒装；'stand to lose/gain'意为'很可能损失/获益'，为地道商务表达。

long.en: The novelist's ability to weave historical facts into a deeply personal narrative accounts for the book's enduring appeal.
long.zh: 这位小说家把历史事实编织进深切个人叙事的能力，解释了该书持久的吸引力。
long.structure: 主干为'The novelist's ability accounts for the book's appeal'；to weave...为不定式作后置定语修饰ability；into a narrative为状语。
long.idiom: 'weave A into B'意为'把A融入B'；'account for'指'解释、说明……的原因'。

long.en: Granted that technology can boost productivity, it by no means guarantees a fairer distribution of its benefits.
long.zh: 就算技术能提升生产力，它也绝不代表其收益能更公平地分配。
long.structure: 'Granted that'引导让步状语从句；主句为'it guarantees a distribution'；by no means为否定状语；of its benefits为后置定语。
long.idiom: 'granted that'意为'即便、承认'；'by no means'表'绝不'，置于谓语前引起部分强调。

long.en: The more reliant a community becomes on a single industry, the more vulnerable it is to external economic shocks.
long.zh: 一个社区对单一产业依赖越深，它受外部经济冲击的影响就越脆弱。
long.structure: 'The more..., the more...'为比较级特殊句型；主句为'it is vulnerable to shocks'；reliant on...作表语；to external shocks为状语。
long.idiom: 'the more...the more...'表'越……越……'；'vulnerable to shocks'指'易受冲击影响'。

long.en: Critics contend that the scheme, billed as a breakthrough, merely shifts the problem elsewhere rather than resolving it.
long.zh: 批评者认为，这个被称作突破的方案只是把问题转移到别处，而非解决它。
long.structure: 主句为'Critics contend that...'；that宾语从句中the scheme作主语，billed as...为过去分词作后置定语；rather than连接对比谓语。
long.idiom: 'billed as'意为'被宣传为'；'shift the problem elsewhere'指'把问题转移他处'。

long.en: Once the initial euphoria subsided, citizens began to grapple with the practical consequences of the sweeping reform.
long.zh: 最初的狂热消退后，市民开始努力应对这场全面改革的实际后果。
long.structure: 'Once'引导时间状语从句；主句为'citizens began to grapple with the consequences'；of the reform为后置定语。
long.idiom: 'once'表'一旦/……之后'；'grapple with'意为'努力应对、尽力解决'，为写作高频动词短语。

long.en: The study's authors caution against interpreting the correlation as causation, noting that other variables may be at play.
long.zh: 该研究作者提醒不要把相关性解读为因果，并指出其他变量可能在起作用。
long.structure: 主干为'The authors caution against interpreting...'；as causation为宾语补足；noting that...为现在分词作伴随状语，带宾语从句。
long.idiom: 'caution against'意为'警告/提醒不要'；'correlation vs causation'是学术写作核心概念；'at play'指'在起作用'。

long.en: Hardly had the new policy taken effect when opposition groups launched a coordinated campaign to overturn it.
long.zh: 新政策刚生效，反对团体就发起了一场协调一致的运动来推翻它。
long.structure: 'Hardly had...when...'为固定句型，主句部分倒装（had taken）；when引导时间状语从句；to overturn it为目的状语。
long.idiom: 'hardly...when...'意为'一……就……'且前句须倒装；'launch a campaign'指'发起运动'。

long.en: What we often overlook is that technological progress, for all its benefits, tends to deepen the divide between rich and poor.
long.zh: 我们常忽视的是，技术进步尽管好处多多，却往往加深贫富鸿沟。
long.structure: 主干为'What we overlook is that...'主语从句+表语从句；that从句中for all its benefits为让步状语；tends to deepen为谓语。
long.idiom: 'for all its benefits'意为'尽管好处多多'；'deepen the divide'指'加深鸿沟'，为议论文地道搭配。

long.en: The court ruled that the evidence, having been obtained unlawfully, must be excluded from the proceedings.
long.zh: 法庭裁定，该证据因系非法获取，必须从诉讼程序中排除。
long.structure: 主句为'The court ruled that...'；that宾语从句中the evidence作主语，having been obtained...为分词完成被动式作原因状语；must be excluded为谓语。
long.idiom: 'rule that'意为'裁定'；'exclude from the proceedings'指'从诉讼程序中排除'。

long.en: Inasmuch as the proposal addresses inequality, it fails to tackle the structural causes that perpetuate the problem.
long.zh: 尽管该提案触及了不平等，它却未能解决使问题长期存在的结构性根源。
long.structure: 'Inasmuch as'引导让步/原因状语从句；主句为'it fails to tackle the causes'；that perpetuate...为定语从句修饰causes。
long.idiom: 'inasmuch as'为正式'尽管/由于'；'tackle the root causes'指'解决根源'；'perpetuate'意为'使长期存在'。

long.en: The mayor's pledge to revitalize the downtown area was met with skepticism by residents who had heard similar promises before.
long.zh: 市长重振市中心的承诺，遭到了曾听过类似承诺的居民们的怀疑。
long.structure: 主干为'The mayor's pledge was met with skepticism'；to revitalize...为不定式作后置定语；by residents为动作发出者；who引导定语从句。
long.idiom: 'be met with skepticism'意为'遭到怀疑'；'revitalize the downtown'指'重振市中心'。

long.en: Seldom do voters reward politicians who deliver inconvenient truths rather than the reassuring slogans they prefer.
long.zh: 选民很少奖赏那些说出不便真相、而非他们偏爱的宽慰性口号的政客。
long.structure: 'Seldom'否定副词前置引起主句部分倒装（do voters reward）；who引导定语从句修饰politicians；rather than连接对比宾语。
long.idiom: 'seldom'前置须倒装；'inconvenient truths'指'令人不安的真相'；'reassuring slogans'指'宽慰性口号'。

long.en: The rapid urbanization of the region, coupled with weak planning, has placed enormous strain on already overstretched infrastructure.
long.zh: 该地区快速的城市化，加上规划薄弱，已给本就超负荷的基础设施带来巨大压力。
long.structure: 主干为'The rapid urbanization has placed strain on infrastructure'；coupled with...为插入定语；already overstretched为前置修饰infrastructure。
long.idiom: 'coupled with'意为'加上、连同'；'place strain on'指'给……施压'；'overstretched'意为'超负荷的'。

long.en: That the two nations reached a tentative accord after years of hostility is a testament to the power of patient diplomacy.
long.zh: 两国在多年敌对后达成初步协议，证明了耐心外交的力量。
long.structure: 主干为'That...is a testament to...'主语从句+系表；that引导主语从句；after years of hostility为时间状语；to the power为后置定语。
long.idiom: 'tentative accord'指'初步协议'；'a testament to'意为'……的证明'；'patient diplomacy'指'耐心外交'。

long.en: No sooner had the results been announced than the stock price plummeted, wiping out billions in market value.
long.zh: 结果一公布，股价便暴跌，蒸发了数十亿市值。
long.structure: 'No sooner had...than...'固定句型，主句倒装（had been announced）；than引导从句；wiping out...为现在分词作结果状语。
long.idiom: 'no sooner...than...'意为'一……就……'且前句倒装；'wipe out'指'抹去、蒸发（价值）'。

long.en: The teacher emphasized that rote memorization, though useful for basics, pales in comparison with genuine understanding.
long.zh: 老师强调，死记硬背尽管对基础有用，但与真正的理解相比便黯然失色。
long.structure: 主句为'The teacher emphasized that...'；that从句中rote memorization作主语，though useful...为让步状语；pales in comparison with为谓语。
long.idiom: 'rote memorization'指'死记硬背'；'pale in comparison with'意为'与……相比相形见绌'。

long.en: Whether the new trade agreement will benefit smaller economies depends on concessions that larger partners are willing to make.
long.zh: 新贸易协定能否惠及较小经济体，取决于较大伙伴愿作出的让步。
long.structure: 主干为'Whether...depends on concessions'主语从句+谓语；that larger partners...为定语从句修饰concessions；are willing to make为谓语。
long.idiom: 'whether...depends on'表'是否……取决于'；'make concessions'指'作出让步'。

long.en: Burdened by debt and shrinking revenues, the institution was forced to curtail programs that served marginalized communities.
long.zh: 受债务与收入萎缩所累，该机构被迫削减服务于边缘群体的项目。
long.structure: 'Burdened by...'为过去分词作原因状语；主句为'the institution was forced to curtail programs'；that served...为定语从句修饰programs。
long.idiom: 'burdened by'意为'受……拖累'；'curtail programs'指'削减项目'；'marginalized communities'指'边缘群体'。

long.en: The historian argued that the revolution, far from being spontaneous, had been decades in the making.
long.zh: 这位历史学家认为，那场革命远非自发，而是历经数十年酝酿而成。
long.structure: 主句为'The historian argued that...'；that从句中the revolution作主语，far from being spontaneous为插入状语；had been decades in the making为谓语。
long.idiom: 'far from being'意为'远非'；'be decades in the making'指'历经数十年酝酿/形成'。

long.en: Little did the explorers realize that the cave they had entered was the habitat of a species thought to be extinct.
long.zh: 探险者们几乎没意识到，他们进入的洞穴是一种被认为已灭绝物种的栖息地。
long.structure: 'Little'否定副词前置引起主句部分倒装（did the explorers realize）；that引导宾语从句；they had entered为定语从句；thought to be extinct为后置定语。
long.idiom: 'little did sb realize'意为'某人几乎没意识到'须倒装；'thought to be'指'被认为'。

long.en: The policy's success hinges on whether local authorities can enforce it consistently across a fragmented administrative landscape.
long.zh: 该政策的成败，取决于地方当局能否在碎片化的行政格局中 consistently 地执行它。
long.structure: 主干为'The policy's success hinges on whether...'；whether引导介词宾语从句；can enforce it为谓语；across...为状语。
long.idiom: 'hinge on'意为'取决于、关键在于'；'enforce consistently'指'持续一致地执行'；'fragmented landscape'指'碎片化格局'。

long.en: Although the medication alleviated her symptoms, it did little to address the underlying condition that caused them.
long.zh: 尽管药物缓解了她的症状，却几乎未触及引发症状的根本病因。
long.structure: 'Although'引导让步状语从句；主句为'it did little to address the condition'；that caused them为定语从句修饰condition。
long.idiom: 'alleviate symptoms'指'缓解症状'；'address the underlying condition'意为'解决根本病因'；'do little to'指'几乎无助于'。

long.en: So abundant were the natural resources that early settlers scarcely imagined the depletion that future generations would face.
long.zh: 自然资源如此丰富，以至于早期定居者几乎无法想象后代将面临的枯竭。
long.structure: 'So abundant'前置引起主句部分倒装（were the resources）；that引导结果状语从句；that future generations...为定语从句修饰depletion。
long.idiom: 'so...that...'倒装结构；'scarcely imagine'指'几乎无法想象'；'depletion'意为'枯竭'。

long.en: The diplomat's remark, carefully calibrated to avoid offense, was nonetheless interpreted as a thinly veiled threat.
long.zh: 这位外交官的言论经过精心措辞以避免冒犯，却仍被解读为近乎露骨的威胁。
long.structure: 主干为'The diplomat's remark was interpreted as a threat'；carefully calibrated...为过去分词作后置定语；nonetheless为副词表转折。
long.idiom: 'carefully calibrated'指'精心措辞/拿捏的'；'thinly veiled'意为'近乎露骨的、掩饰薄弱的'。

long.en: Provided that funding is secured, the research team intends to expand the trial to a far larger and more diverse cohort.
long.zh: 假若能获得资金，研究团队打算把试验扩展到规模更大、更具多样性的人群。
long.structure: 'Provided that'引导条件状语从句（被动）；主句为'the team intends to expand the trial'；to a cohort为状语；larger and more diverse为前置修饰。
long.idiom: 'provided that'意为'假若、只要'；'a diverse cohort'指'多样化人群/队列'，常见于科研。

long.en: The artist's later works, in stark contrast to her earlier pieces, reveal a preoccupation with mortality and transcendence.
long.zh: 这位艺术家后期的作品与早期作品形成鲜明对比，流露出对死亡与超越的执着。
long.structure: 主干为'The artist's later works reveal a preoccupation'；in stark contrast to...为插入状语；with mortality...为后置定语修饰preoccupation。
long.idiom: 'in stark contrast to'意为'与……形成鲜明对比'；'a preoccupation with'指'对……的执着/关注'。

long.en: It is precisely because the costs are hidden that consumers continue to behave in ways that undermine their own interests.
long.zh: 恰恰因为成本被隐藏，消费者才继续以损害自身利益的方式行事。
long.structure: 'It is...that...'强调句型，强调原因状语从句'because the costs are hidden'；主句为'consumers continue to behave'；that undermine...为定语从句。
long.idiom: 'it is precisely because...that'强调'恰恰因为'；'undermine one's interests'指'损害某人利益'。

long.en: The committee's reluctance to act stems from a fear that any intervention might backfire and inflame tensions further.
long.zh: 委员会不愿行动，源于一种担忧：任何干预都可能适得其反，进一步激化矛盾。
long.structure: 主干为'The committee's reluctance stems from a fear'；to act为不定式定语；that any intervention...为同位语从句解释fear；might backfire and inflame为并列谓语。
long.idiom: 'stem from'意为'源于'；'backfire'指'适得其反、事与愿违'；'inflame tensions'指'激化矛盾'。

long.en: Rarely has a single invention so profoundly reshaped daily life as the smartphone, for better and for worse.
long.zh: 鲜有一项发明能像智能手机那样深刻地重塑日常生活，无论好坏。
long.structure: 'Rarely'否定副词前置引起主句部分倒装（has a single invention reshaped）；as引导比较；for better and for worse为评注状语。
long.idiom: 'rarely'前置须倒装；'for better and for worse'意为'无论好坏、利弊兼具'。

long.en: The government's pledge to phase out coal, while ambitious, collides with the reality of an economy still hooked on cheap power.
long.zh: 政府逐步淘汰煤炭的承诺虽有雄心，却与一个仍依赖廉价电力的经济现实相冲突。
long.structure: 主干为'The government's pledge collides with the reality'；to phase out coal为定语；while ambitious为让步状语；still hooked on...为后置定语修饰economy。
long.idiom: 'phase out'意为'逐步淘汰'；'collide with'指'与……冲突'；'hooked on'意为'沉迷/依赖'。

long.en: What the data unequivocally show is that inequality has widened not in spite of growth but because of the way it is distributed.
long.zh: 数据明确显示的是，不平等的扩大并非不顾增长，而是源于增长成果的分配方式。
long.structure: 主干为'What the data show is that...'主语从句+表语从句；that从句中not...but...连接对比原因；because of...为原因状语。
long.idiom: 'unequivocally show'指'明确显示'；'not in spite of but because of'为高级对比结构。

long.en: The refugees, having fled violence at home, found themselves caught between a hostile border and an indifferent world.
long.zh: 这些难民逃离了故土的暴力，却发现自己夹在充满敌意的边境与冷漠的世界之间。
long.structure: 'The refugees found themselves caught'为主句；having fled...为分词完成式作原因状语；between...and...为状语。
long.idiom: 'flee violence'指'逃离暴力'；'find oneself caught between'意为'发现自己夹在……之间'；'indifferent'指'冷漠的'。

long.en: Just as the printing press transformed the Renaissance, so digital networks are reshaping the contours of modern society.
long.zh: 正如印刷机改变了文艺复兴，数字网络也正在重塑现代社会的轮廓。
long.structure: 'Just as...so...'为类比结构；前半句为比较状语从句，主句'so digital networks are reshaping...'中so表'同样'。
long.idiom: 'just as A, so B'意为'正如A，B也……'；'reshape the contours'指'重塑轮廓/形态'。

long.en: The court's decision, widely expected yet nonetheless consequential, set a precedent that will constrain future regulators.
long.zh: 这一广受预期却仍具影响的法院裁决，树立了一个将约束未来监管者的先例。
long.structure: 主干为'The court's decision set a precedent'；widely expected yet nonetheless consequential为并列后置定语；that will constrain...为定语从句。
long.idiom: 'set a precedent'意为'树立先例'；'constrain regulators'指'约束监管者'；'consequential'指'重要的、有影响的'。

long.en: Were the current trajectory to continue, the planet would breach several ecological thresholds within a single generation.
long.zh: 若当前趋势延续，地球将在一代人的时间内突破若干生态临界值。
long.structure: 'Were the trajectory to continue'为虚拟条件句倒装（相当于If...were to continue）；主句为'the planet would breach thresholds'；within...为时间状语。
long.idiom: 'were...to continue'表对将来的虚拟；'breach thresholds'指'突破临界值'，生态类写作高频。

long.en: The novelist spares no detail in depicting a society so stratified that mobility between classes has become all but impossible.
long.zh: 小说家不遗巨细地描绘了一个阶层如此固化、阶层间流动几乎不可能社会。
long.structure: 主干为'The novelist spares no detail in depicting a society'；so stratified that...为结果状语从句；between classes为定语；all but impossible为表语。
long.idiom: 'spare no detail'意为'不遗余力地详述'；'all but impossible'指'几乎不可能'；'stratified'意为'分层的'。

long.en: Not every innovation lives up to the hype, and many promising technologies fail to deliver on their early promise.
long.zh: 并非每项创新都名副其实，许多前景看好的技术未能兑现其早期的承诺。
long.structure: 'Not every...'否定主语；and连接并列句；many technologies作后句主语；fail to deliver on...为谓语；their early promise为宾语。
long.idiom: 'live up to the hype'意为'名副其实/不负盛名'；'deliver on a promise'指'兑现承诺'。

long.en: The summit's modest outcomes, though hailed as progress, fall short of the ambitious targets set at its outset.
long.zh: 峰会有限的成果虽被誉为进步，却未达其初始设定的宏大目标。
long.structure: 主干为'The summit's outcomes fall short of the targets'；though hailed as...为让步状语；set at its outset为过去分词作后置定语。
long.idiom: 'fall short of'意为'未达到、辜负'；'hailed as'指'被誉为'；'at its outset'指'在其开始时'。

long.en: Because trust, once lost, is exceedingly difficult to regain, institutions must guard it as their most precious asset.
long.zh: 因为信任一旦失去便极难挽回，机构必须将其当作最宝贵的资产来守护。
long.structure: 'Because'引导原因状语从句，once lost为插入省略状语；主句为'institutions must guard it'；as their most precious asset为状语。
long.idiom: 'once lost'省略结构意为'一旦失去'；'guard as'指'把……当作……来守护'。

long.en: The engineer's elegant solution, simple in principle yet formidable in execution, resolved a problem deemed unsolvable.
long.zh: 这位工程师优雅的方案，原理简单却执行艰难，解决了一个被认为无解的问题。
long.structure: 主干为'The engineer's solution resolved a problem'；simple in principle yet formidable in execution为并列后置定语；deemed unsolvable为后置定语修饰problem。
long.idiom: 'elegant solution'指'巧妙/优雅的方案'；'deemed unsolvable'意为'被认为无解的'。

long.en: Only when citizens hold their leaders accountable can democracy fulfill the promise of serving the common good.
long.zh: 只有当公民让领导者承担责任，民主才能兑现服务公共利益的承诺。
long.structure: 'Only when'引导时间状语从句前置，主句部分倒装（can democracy fulfill）；of serving...为后置定语修饰promise。
long.idiom: 'hold sb accountable'意为'让某人负责'；'the common good'指'公共利益'，政治写作核心词。

long.en: The film's power lies less in its plot than in its unflinching portrayal of ordinary lives under extraordinary strain.
long.zh: 这部电影的力量不在于剧情，而在于它对非凡压力下普通人生活的坦诚刻画。
long.structure: 主干为'The film's power lies less in...than in...'；less...than...表对比；under extraordinary strain为后置定语修饰lives。
long.idiom: 'lie less in A than in B'意为'不在于A而在于B'；'unflinching portrayal'指'坦诚/无畏的刻画'。

long.en: Such is the pace of change that entire industries can vanish before regulators have time to comprehend their impact.
long.zh: 变化之快，以至于整个行业可能在监管者来得及理解其影响之前就消失。
long.structure: 'Such is the pace...'为such前置引起的倒装（主语pace后置）；that引导结果状语从句；before...为时间状语从句。
long.idiom: 'such is...that'表'如此……以至于'且主句倒装；'vanish before sb has time to'指'在某人来不及……前消失'。

long.en: The proposal, if implemented as written, would concentrate power in ways that unsettled even its own supporters.
long.zh: 该提案若按文本实施，将以令其支持者自身都不安的方式集中权力。
long.structure: 主句为'The proposal would concentrate power'；if implemented as written为省略状语从句；in ways that...为状语，带定语从句。
long.idiom: 'as written'意为'按文本/字面'；'concentrate power'指'集中权力'；'unsettled'作动词指'使不安'。

long.en: What ultimately swayed the voters was not the candidate's charisma but the concrete policies she put forward.
long.zh: 最终打动选民的，不是候选人的个人魅力，而是她提出的具体政策。
long.structure: 主干为'What swayed the voters was not...but...'主语从句+并列表语；she put forward为定语从句修饰policies。
long.idiom: 'sway the voters'意为'打动/影响选民'；'put forward policies'指'提出政策'。

long.en: The region's recovery, fragile and uneven, remains hostage to forces beyond the control of its own policymakers.
long.zh: 该地区脆弱而不均衡的复苏，仍受制于其决策者无法掌控的力量。
long.structure: 主干为'The region's recovery remains hostage to forces'；fragile and uneven为后置定语；beyond the control...为后置定语修饰forces。
long.idiom: 'remain hostage to'意为'受制于、受……裹挟'；'beyond one's control'指'超出某人掌控'。

speak.en: I really need a cup of coffee to kick off my morning.
speak.zh: 我真的需要一杯咖啡来开启早晨。

speak.en: Could you please repeat that sentence a little more slowly?
speak.zh: 你能把那句话再说慢一点吗？

speak.en: I'm planning to apply for a master's program next year.
speak.zh: 我打算明年申请硕士项目。

speak.en: Let's grab a bite to eat before the meeting starts.
speak.zh: 会议开始前我们随便吃点东西吧。

speak.en: The weather forecast says it might rain later today.
speak.zh: 天气预报说今天晚些时候可能会下雨。

speak.en: I totally agree with what you just said about teamwork.
speak.zh: 我完全同意你刚才关于团队合作的看法。

speak.en: Could you recommend a good local restaurant around here?
speak.zh: 你能推荐一家这附近不错的本地餐厅吗？

speak.en: I was stuck in traffic for nearly an hour this morning.
speak.zh: 今天早上我堵车堵了快一个小时。

speak.en: Learning a language takes patience and daily practice.
speak.zh: 学一门语言需要耐心和每日练习。

speak.en: We should wrap up this discussion and make a decision.
speak.zh: 我们该结束讨论并做个决定了。

speak.en: My laptop suddenly crashed and I lost all my work.
speak.zh: 我的笔记本突然死机，工作全丢了。

speak.en: Let me check my schedule and get back to you soon.
speak.zh: 我查一下日程，马上回复你。

speak.en: Traveling abroad really broadens your horizon, I think.
speak.zh: 我觉得出国旅行真的能开阔眼界。

speak.en: I'm not a big fan of horror movies, to be honest.
speak.zh: 说实话，我不太喜欢恐怖片。

speak.en: Could we reschedule the interview to next Tuesday?
speak.zh: 我们能把面试改到下周二吗？

speak.en: The new policy will take effect from the first of July.
speak.zh: 新政策将从七月一日起生效。

speak.en: I'd rather stay in and read than go out tonight.
speak.zh: 今晚我宁愿待在家里看书也不想出门。

speak.en: She gave a brilliant presentation at the conference yesterday.
speak.zh: 她昨天在会上做了场精彩的展示。

speak.en: Let's keep in touch after you move to the new city.
speak.zh: 你搬去新城市后我们保持联系吧。

speak.en: I'm running a bit late, so please start without me.
speak.zh: 我要晚一点，你们先开始吧。

speak.en: The customer service was surprisingly helpful and polite.
speak.zh: 客服出人意料地有帮助而且礼貌。

speak.en: We need to cut down on our monthly expenses somehow.
speak.zh: 我们得想办法减少每月开支了。

speak.en: I find it hard to concentrate when the room is noisy.
speak.zh: 房间吵的时候我很难集中注意力。

speak.en: Would you mind switching off your phone during the film?
speak.zh: 电影期间你介意关掉手机吗？

speak.en: He apologized for forgetting our dinner appointment last night.
speak.zh: 他为忘了昨晚的饭局道了歉。

speak.en: The view from the top of the mountain was absolutely worth it.
speak.zh: 山顶的景色绝对值得这一趟。

speak.en: I usually unwind by listening to music after a long day.
speak.zh: 漫长的一天后我通常听音乐来放松。

speak.en: Could you point me to the nearest subway station, please?
speak.zh: 请问能告诉我最近的地铁站在哪吗？

speak.en: Our team managed to meet the deadline against all odds.
speak.zh: 我们团队最终克服万难赶上了截止日期。

speak.en: I'm thinking about picking up a new hobby this summer.
speak.zh: 我在考虑今年夏天培养个新爱好。

speak.en: The lecture was a bit over my head, to tell the truth.
speak.zh: 说实话，那场讲座我有点听不懂。

speak.en: Let's split the bill since we ordered different things.
speak.zh: 我们点的不一样，那就AA吧。

speak.en: I'm afraid I have to turn down the job offer, sorry.
speak.zh: 抱歉，我恐怕得拒绝那份工作邀请了。

speak.en: Reading before bed helps me fall asleep much faster.
speak.zh: 睡前阅读帮我更快入睡。

speak.en: We got lost, but a local kindly showed us the way.
speak.zh: 我们迷路了，但一位当地人热心指了路。

speak.en: The project is behind schedule because of staff shortages.
speak.zh: 由于人手不足，项目进度落后了。

speak.en: I can't thank you enough for all the help you gave me.
speak.zh: 你给我的帮助我感激不尽。

speak.en: Let's give it a shot and see what happens, shall we?
speak.zh: 我们试一试看看结果吧，好吗？

speak.en: She's been burning the candle at both ends lately.
speak.zh: 她最近一直在过度操劳。

speak.en: I prefer working from home to commuting every day.
speak.zh: 比起每天通勤，我更喜欢在家工作。

speak.en: The queue at the pharmacy was longer than I expected.
speak.zh: 药房排队的人比我想的要多。

speak.en: Could you spare a few minutes to review my draft?
speak.zh: 你能抽几分钟看一下我的草稿吗？

speak.en: I'm not convinced that the plan will actually work.
speak.zh: 我不太相信这计划真能行得通。

speak.en: We should seize the opportunity before it slips away.
speak.zh: 我们应在机会溜走前抓住它。

speak.en: My neighbor offered to water my plants while I'm away.
speak.zh: 我邻居提出我不在时帮我浇花。

speak.en: The museum is free to enter on the first Sunday monthly.
speak.zh: 博物馆每月第一个周日免费开放。

speak.en: I tend to overthink things when I'm under pressure.
speak.zh: 压力大时我容易想太多。

speak.en: Let's touch base next week to review the progress.
speak.zh: 我们下周碰一下，回顾下进展。

speak.en: He speaks three languages fluently and is learning a fourth.
speak.zh: 他说三种语言都很流利，还在学第四种。

speak.en: I was blown away by the performance last night, honestly.
speak.zh: 说实话，昨晚的演出让我惊艳。

speak.en: We'd better leave now or we'll miss the last train.
speak.zh: 我们最好现在走，不然要错过末班车了。

speak.en: The app makes it easy to track your daily spending.
speak.zh: 这个应用让你轻松记录每日开销。

speak.en: I'm on a tight budget this month, so no shopping.
speak.zh: 这个月我手头紧，就不逛街了。

speak.en: Could you fill me in on what happened at the meeting?
speak.zh: 你能跟我说说会上发生了什么吗？

speak.en: She nailed the interview and got the job on the spot.
speak.zh: 她面试表现出色，当场就拿到了工作。

speak.en: I'm trying to cut back on sugar for health reasons.
speak.zh: 为了健康我正试着少吃糖。

speak.en: Let's call it a day and pick up where we left off.
speak.zh: 今天就到这，我们接着上次的地方继续。

speak.en: The baby kept us up all night with a terrible fever.
speak.zh: 宝宝高烧，整晚吵得我们没睡。

speak.en: I'm a firm believer in learning from your own mistakes.
speak.zh: 我坚信要从自己的错误中学习。

speak.en: Would you like to join us for a walk along the river?
speak.zh: 你想和我们一起去河边散步吗？

speak.en: The flight was delayed, so we hung around the airport.
speak.zh: 航班延误了，我们就在机场闲逛。

speak.en: I'll take the blame for the mix-up, it was my fault.
speak.zh: 混乱的事我担责，是我的问题。

speak.en: We should give credit where credit is truly due.
speak.zh: 该表扬的地方就应好好表扬。

speak.en: He's always the first to lend a hand when needed.
speak.zh: 需要帮忙时他总是第一个伸出援手。

speak.en: I'm weighing the pros and cons before making a choice.
speak.zh: 我在权衡利弊，然后再做选择。

speak.en: The café on the corner has the best croissants in town.
speak.zh: 街角那家咖啡馆有全镇最好的可颂。

speak.en: Let me sleep on it and give you an answer tomorrow.
speak.zh: 让我想想，明天给你答复。

speak.en: I'm knackered after the long hike up the hill.
speak.zh: 爬完那座山我累坏了。

speak.en: She handled the complaint with great tact and calm.
speak.zh: 她处理投诉时既得体又冷静。

speak.en: We might as well cancel the trip given the storm warning.
speak.zh: 既然有风暴预警，我们不如取消行程。

speak.en: I lost track of time while I was absorbed in the book.
speak.zh: 我看書看入迷，不知不觉忘了时间。

speak.en: Could you hold the lift, please? I'm on my way down.
speak.zh: 能帮我按着电梯吗？我这就下来。

speak.en: The teacher encouraged us to think outside the box.
speak.zh: 老师鼓励我们跳出思维定式。

speak.en: I'm not cut out for a desk job, to be perfectly honest.
speak.zh: 坦白说，我真不适合坐办公室的工作。

speak.en: Let's grab a coffee and talk this through properly.
speak.zh: 我们喝杯咖啡，好好把这事聊清楚。

speak.en: He brushed off the criticism and kept working quietly.
speak.zh: 他对批评不以为意，继续默默工作。

speak.en: I'm saving up for a trip to Japan next spring.
speak.zh: 我在攒钱，准备明年春天去日本。

speak.en: The Wi-Fi here is patchy, so the call kept dropping.
speak.zh: 这的Wi-Fi不稳定，电话一直断。

speak.en: We should look on the bright side of the situation.
speak.zh: 我们应看到情况乐观的一面。

speak.en: I appreciate you taking the time to explain it to me.
speak.zh: 谢谢你抽时间给我讲解。

speak.en: The concert was sold out within minutes of going live.
speak.zh: 音乐会开售几分钟就售罄了。

speak.en: Let's not beat around the bush and discuss the issue.
speak.zh: 我们别拐弯抹角了，直接谈问题吧。

speak.en: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, to be fair.
speak.zh: 说实在的，我今天有点不舒服。

speak.en: She's the glue that holds the whole team together.
speak.zh: 她是让整个团队凝聚在一起的核心。

speak.en: I'll double-check the figures before I send the report.
speak.zh: 发报告前我会再核对一遍数据。

speak.en: We ended up chatting for hours without even noticing.
speak.zh: 我们最后聊了几个小时都没察觉。

speak.en: Could you keep an eye on my bag while I buy a ticket?
speak.zh: 我买票时你能帮我看下包吗？

speak.en: I always make a to-do list to stay on top of things.
speak.zh: 我总列待办清单来掌控事务。

speak.en: The landlord agreed to fix the heater before winter.
speak.zh: 房东同意在冬天前修好暖气。

speak.en: We cheered when our team scored the winning goal.
speak.zh: 我们队进了制胜球时我们欢呼起来。

reading.title: A Healthy Breakfast Starts the Day
reading.body:
Breakfast is the first meal of the day. Many people say it is the most important one.

A good breakfast gives you energy for work and school. Eggs, bread, and fruit are common choices.

Some people like milk or juice with their meal. These drinks help keep the body strong.

Skipping breakfast can make you feel tired. You may find it hard to focus in the morning.

Try to eat a simple, healthy breakfast every day. It is a small habit that helps a lot.
reading.zh:
早餐是一天中的第一餐。许多人说它是最重要的一餐。

一顿好的早餐为你工作和学习提供能量。鸡蛋、面包和水果是常见的选择。

有些人喜欢在餐中配牛奶或果汁。这些饮品有助于保持身体强壮。

不吃早餐会让你感到疲惫。你可能会发现早上很难集中注意力。

试着每天吃一些简单、健康的早餐。这是一个帮助很大的小习惯。
reading.analysis: 用词基础、句式简短，适合初级学习者积累日常词汇。可重点学习 give energy、focus、skip 等实用动词搭配。

reading.title: Walking Is Good Exercise
reading.body:
Walking is one of the easiest ways to stay healthy. You do not need special equipment.

A short walk after dinner can help your body digest food. It also clears your mind.

Many cities now have parks and walking paths. People of all ages can enjoy them.

Doctors suggest about thirty minutes of walking each day. This small step improves your heart.

You can walk with a friend or listen to music. The key is to keep moving.
reading.zh:
步行是保持健康最简单的方式之一。你不需要特殊装备。

晚饭后短距离散步有助于身体消化食物。它也能让你头脑清醒。

许多城市现在都有公园和步行道。各个年龄段的人都可以享受它们。

医生建议每天步行约三十分钟。这一小步能改善你的心脏健康。

你可以和朋友一起走，或听听音乐。关键是保持运动。
reading.analysis: 运用了 suggest、improve、digest 等动词，句型以简单句为主。可学习 equipment、digest、heart 等健康主题词汇。

reading.title: Learning a New Language
reading.body:
Learning a new language opens the door to new friends. It also helps you understand other cultures.

You can start with simple words and daily greetings. Practice a little every day.

Watching films and listening to songs makes learning fun. Try to repeat what you hear.

Do not worry about mistakes. They are a normal part of learning.

With time and patience, your speaking will improve. The journey is rewarding.
reading.zh:
学习一门新语言为结交新朋友打开了大门。它也帮助你理解其他文化。

你可以从简单单词和日常问候开始。每天练习一点点。

看电影和听歌曲让学习变得有趣。试着重复你听到的内容。

不要担心犯错。它们是学习过程中正常的一部分。

随着时间和耐心，你的口语会进步。这段旅程是值得的。
reading.analysis: 以 opens the door to、rewarding 等表达展现地道搭配。疑问句与祈使句并用，适合练习基础交际用语。

reading.title: The Habit of Reading
reading.body:
Reading is a quiet habit that brings great joy. A book can take you to another world.

You do not need to read thick books at first. Short stories are a good start.

Reading before bed helps you relax. It is better than looking at a phone screen.

Libraries are free and full of choices. You can borrow books without paying.

Make reading a daily routine. Even ten minutes a day is useful.
reading.zh:
阅读是一种带来巨大快乐的安静习惯。一本书可以把你带去另一个世界。

一开始你不需要读很厚的书。短篇故事是个好的开始。

睡前阅读能帮助你放松。它比看手机屏幕更好。

图书馆是免费的，且充满选择。你可以不花钱借书。

让阅读成为日常习惯。即使每天十分钟也很有用。
reading.analysis: 使用了 routine、borrow、relax 等生活词汇。thick books、phone screen 等对比表达自然，便于初级积累。

reading.title: How to Save Water at Home
reading.body:
Water is a precious resource in our daily life. We should use it with care.

Turn off the tap while brushing your teeth. This simple act saves many litres.

Fix leaking pipes as soon as you notice them. A small leak wastes a lot over time.

Collect rainwater to water your plants. It is free and good for the garden.

Small changes at home protect our rivers and lakes. Everyone can help.
reading.zh:
水是我们日常生活中宝贵的资源。我们应该小心使用它。

刷牙时关掉水龙头。这个简单的动作能节省很多升水。

一发现漏水的水管就修理。小小的漏水时间久了也会浪费很多。

收集雨水来浇植物。它免费且对花园有益。

在家里的小改变能保护我们的河流与湖泊。每个人都能帮忙。
reading.analysis: 围绕环保主题展开，含 turn off、fix、collect 等动作动词。可学习 precious resource、leaking pipe 等实用搭配。

reading.title: My Favourite Season
reading.body:
Autumn is my favourite season of the year. The weather becomes cool and pleasant.

The leaves turn red, orange, and gold. The trees look like a painting.

I enjoy walking in the park during autumn. The air smells fresh after the rain.

Many fruits and nuts are ready to harvest. Markets become colourful and busy.

Autumn reminds me to slow down and be thankful. It is a calm and gentle time.
reading.zh:
秋天是我一年中最喜欢的季节。天气变得凉爽而宜人。

树叶变成红色、橙色和金色。树木看起来像一幅画。

我喜欢在秋天散步于公园。雨后空气闻起来很清新。

许多水果和坚果准备收获。市场变得五彩缤纷且热闹。

秋天提醒我慢下来并心怀感恩。它是一个平静而温柔的时节。
reading.analysis: 运用 turn、remind、slow down 等表达描绘季节。形容词丰富（pleasant, fresh, calm），适合积累描写性词汇。

reading.title: A Visit to the Market
reading.body:
On Saturday morning I went to the local market. It was full of colour and sound.

Farmers sold fresh vegetables and sweet fruit. The prices were fair and low.

I bought bread, eggs, and some flowers. The seller smiled and said hello.

There was music from a small radio nearby. The whole place felt warm and alive.

Markets are more than shops. They are a meeting place for the community.
reading.zh:
周六早晨我去了当地的市场。那里充满了色彩与声音。

农民们卖新鲜的蔬菜和甜美的水果。价格公道且便宜。

我买了面包、鸡蛋和一些花。卖家微笑着说了声你好。

附近一台小收音机播放着音乐。整个地方让人感到温暖而充满生气。

市场不仅仅是商店。它们是社区相聚的地方。
reading.analysis: 以一般过去时叙述经历，含 went、bought、sold 等不规则动词。fair price、local market 等表达实用。

reading.title: Why We Need Sleep
reading.body:
Sleep is as important as food and water. Our bodies repair themselves at night.

Children need more sleep than adults. About nine hours is good for growing bodies.

Lack of sleep makes us angry and slow. We cannot think clearly the next day.

A dark, quiet room helps you fall asleep. Avoid screens an hour before bed.

Good sleep builds a strong memory. It keeps your mood bright.
reading.zh:
睡眠与食物和水一样重要。我们的身体在夜间自我修复。

儿童比成人需要更多睡眠。约九个小时对成长中的身体有益。

缺乏睡眠会让我们易怒且反应迟钝。第二天我们无法清晰思考。

黑暗、安静的房间有助于入睡。睡前一小时避免看屏幕。

良好睡眠能增强记忆力。它让你的心情保持明亮。
reading.analysis: 科普类短文，含 repair、lack、avoid 等动词。as important as 比较结构及 build memory 搭配值得注意。

reading.title: Making Friends at School
reading.body:
School is a great place to meet new friends. A smile is a good first step.

You can join a club to meet people with the same hobby. Football and art are popular.

Listen when others speak and show interest. People like a kind and patient friend.

Share your lunch or help with homework. Small acts build trust.

True friends support each other in good times and bad. They make school brighter.
reading.zh:
学校是结识新朋友的好地方。微笑是良好的第一步。

你可以加入社团，认识有相同爱好的人。足球和美术很受欢迎。

别人说话时要倾听并表现出兴趣。人们喜欢善良而耐心的朋友。

分享午餐或帮忙做作业。小小的举动能建立信任。

真正的朋友在顺境与逆境中互相支持。他们让学校更明亮。
reading.analysis: 社交主题，含 join、share、support 等动词。same hobby、build trust 等短语适合初级口语表达。

reading.title: The Joy of Cooking
reading.body:
Cooking at home can be fun and cheap. You choose what goes into your food.

Start with easy recipes like salad or fried rice. Follow the steps one by one.

Cooking with family creates happy memories. Everyone can help wash or stir.

Tasting your own dish gives a sense of pride. Even small mistakes taste fine.

Over time you will invent your own meals. The kitchen becomes a place of joy.
reading.zh:
在家做饭可以既有趣又省钱。你选择放入食物中的东西。

从简单的食谱开始，比如沙拉或炒饭。一步一步地照做。

与家人一起做饭能创造快乐回忆。每个人都可以帮忙洗或搅拌。

品尝自己做的菜会带来自豪感。即使小失误也很好吃。

随着时间推移你会发明自己的餐点。厨房变成一个充满欢乐的地方。
reading.analysis: 使用 follow the steps、sense of pride 等地道表达。goes into、invent 等动词生动，适合生活英语积累。

reading.title: Keeping Your Room Tidy
reading.body:
A tidy room helps you think clearly. It also saves time in the morning.

Put your clothes in the wardrobe each night. Do not leave them on a chair.

Keep books on the shelf and papers in a box. Everything should have a place.

Spend five minutes cleaning before bed. The habit keeps mess away.

A clean space brings a calm mind. You will feel more relaxed at home.
reading.zh:
整洁的房间有助于你清晰思考。它也能在早晨节省时间。

每晚把衣服放进衣柜。不要把它们留在椅子上。

把书放在书架上，纸放在盒子里。每样东西都应有其位置。

睡前花五分钟整理。这个习惯能远离杂乱。

干净的空间带来平静的心。你在家里会感到更放松。
reading.analysis: 家务主题，含 put、keep、spend 等动词。everything should have a place 是地道口语表达，值得记诵。

reading.title: A Trip to the Beach
reading.body:
Last summer we drove to a quiet beach. The sand was warm under our feet.

We built a castle and watched the waves. Seabirds flew above the blue water.

My mother packed sandwiches and cold juice. We ate under a big umbrella.

In the evening the sky turned pink. The wind became soft and cool.

The beach trip left us happy and tired. We promised to return next year.
reading.zh:
去年夏天我们开车去了一个安静的海滩。沙子在我们脚下是温暖的。

我们堆了一座城堡并看着海浪。海鸟在蓝色水面上方飞翔。

妈妈准备了三明治和冰果汁。我们在大伞下吃。

傍晚天空变成粉红色。风变得轻柔而凉爽。

海滩之旅让我们开心又疲惫。我们约定明年再来。
reading.analysis: 过去时叙事，含 drove、built、packed 等不规则动词。left us happy and tired 是 useful 的 make/leave + 宾语 + 形容词结构。

reading.title: Using a Smartphone Wisely
reading.body:
Smartphones are useful but can waste our time. We should use them with balance.

Set a timer for games and videos. When it rings, put the phone down.

Use your phone to learn, not only to play. Apps can teach languages and maths.

Turn off notices at night for better sleep. Fewer beeps mean more peace.

A phone is a tool, not a master. You decide how to spend your hours.
reading.zh:
智能手机很有用，但也会浪费我们的时间。我们应该有节制地使用。

为游戏和视频设置计时器。响铃时就放下手机。

用手机学习，而不仅用来玩。应用能教语言和数学。

晚上关闭通知以获得更好睡眠。更少的提示音意味着更多安宁。

手机是工具，不是主人。你决定如何支配你的时间。
reading.analysis: 科技生活主题，含 set a timer、turn off 等短语。not only...but also 结构与 a tool, not a master 比喻值得学习。

reading.title: Plants in the Home
reading.body:
Indoor plants make a home feel fresh and alive. They also clean the air a little.

Choose easy plants like cactus or pothos. They need little care and light.

Water them only when the soil is dry. Too much water can harm the roots.

Place a plant near a window for soft sunlight. Watch it grow week by week.

Caring for plants teaches patience. Green friends calm a busy mind.
reading.zh:
室内植物让家感觉清新而充满生气。它们也能稍微净化空气。

选择容易养的植物，如仙人掌或绿萝。它们几乎不需要照顾和光照。

只在土壤干时浇水。过多水会伤害根部。

把植物放在窗边接受柔和阳光。看着它一周周长大。

照顾植物教会我们耐心。绿色朋友能让忙碌的心平静。
reading.analysis: 含 choose、harm、place 等动词及 cactus、soil、roots 等词汇。teach patience 为地道动宾搭配，便于积累。

reading.title: Helping Parents at Home
reading.body:
Helping at home shows love for your family. Small jobs make a big difference.

You can wash the dishes after dinner. Or you may sweep the floor quickly.

Take out the rubbish when the bin is full. Ask which task your parent needs most.

These acts lighten the load for everyone. The home feels warmer and closer.

Helping is not only work. It is a way to say thank you.
reading.zh:
在家帮忙是对家人的爱的表现。小小的活儿能带来大不同。

你可以在饭后洗碗。或者迅速扫一下地。

垃圾桶满时把垃圾倒掉。问问父母最需要做哪件事。

这些举动减轻了每个人的负担。家变得更温暖、更亲近。

帮忙不只是工作。它是一种道谢的方式。
reading.analysis: 家庭责任主题，含 wash、sweep、lighten 等动词。make a big difference、lighten the load 为实用短语。

reading.title: A Rainy Day
reading.body:
Rain tapped on the window all morning. The sky was a soft shade of grey.

I stayed inside and read an old book. The sound of rain was calming.

My cat slept on the sofa, warm and still. The world outside moved slowly.

Later the rain stopped and birds sang. Wet leaves shone in the light.

A rainy day can be a gift of rest. It invites us to slow our pace.
reading.zh:
雨整个上午敲打着窗户。天空是柔和的灰色。

我待在屋里读一本旧书。雨声令人平静。

我的猫在沙发上睡着，温暖而安静。外面的世界缓慢移动。

后来雨停了，鸟儿歌唱。湿润的树叶在光下闪烁。

雨天可以是休息的礼物。它邀请我们放慢脚步。
reading.analysis: 描写性短文，含 tapped、shone、invite 等动词。a gift of rest、slow our pace 等表达优美，适合积累意象词汇。

reading.title: The Library Near My Home
reading.body:
There is a small library near my home. It is quiet and full of stories.

I borrow books about animals and space. The librarian helps me find them.

On weekends children gather for reading time. They listen and laugh together.

The library also lends free movies and music. A card is all you need.

It is a calm corner of the town. Everyone is welcome there.
reading.zh:
我家附近有一个小图书馆。它安静且充满故事。

我借关于动物和太空的书。图书管理员帮我找到它们。

周末孩子们聚在一起阅读。他们一起听、一起笑。

图书馆还免费借出电影和音乐。你只需要一张卡。

它是小镇上一个安静的角落。那里欢迎每个人。
reading.analysis: there be 句型开篇，含 borrow、gather、lend 等动词。a calm corner 等名词短语便于初级描写地点。

reading.title: Eating More Vegetables
reading.body:
Vegetables keep our bodies strong and light. They are full of vitamins and fibre.

Try to fill half your plate with greens. Carrots, beans, and spinach are great.

You can eat them raw, boiled, or roasted. Different ways bring different tastes.

Add colour to every meal for fun. Red, yellow, and green all help health.

A plate rich in vegetables is a plate of care. Your future self will thank you.
reading.zh:
蔬菜让我们的身体强壮而轻盈。它们富含维他命和纤维。

试着让盘子一半装满绿色蔬菜。胡萝卜、豆类和菠菜都很好。

你可以生吃、煮或烤。不同做法带来不同味道。

为每餐增添色彩以增添乐趣。红、黄、绿都有助健康。

富含蔬菜的盘子是一盘关爱。未来的你会感谢自己。
reading.analysis: 健康饮食主题，含 fill、add、roast 等动词。full of、rich in 等介词短语是描述食物的高频搭配。

reading.title: A Kind Stranger
reading.body:
Yesterday I dropped my books on the bus. A stranger quickly picked them up.

She smiled and said, do not worry, it happens to everyone. Her voice was gentle.

We talked for two stops about school and music. She gave me a nice tip for study.

At my stop she wished me a good day. I felt warm though we were strangers.

Small kindness from others matters. It can brighten a normal grey day.
reading.zh:
昨天我在公交车上掉了书。一位陌生人迅速帮我捡起。

她微笑着说，别担心，这种事谁都会遇到。她的声音很温柔。

我们聊了两站，关于学校和音乐。她给了我一个学习的好建议。

在我那一站她祝我一天愉快。尽管是陌生人，我却感到温暖。

他人小小的善意很重要。它能照亮一个普通的灰色日子。
reading.analysis: 叙事含 dropped、picked up、wished 等动词。it happens to everyone、brighten a day 等地道表达适合口语。

reading.title: Learning to Ride a Bike
reading.body:
My father taught me to ride a bike at age seven. At first I was afraid to fall.

He held the seat and ran beside me. Slowly I found my balance and speed.

After a week I rode alone down the street. The wind on my face felt free.

Now I bike to school instead of taking the bus. It keeps me fit and happy.

Falling is part of learning. Standing up again is what really counts.
reading.zh:
我父亲在我七岁时教我骑自行车。一开始我害怕摔倒。

他扶着车座在旁边跑。慢慢地我找到了平衡与速度。

一周后我独自骑到街上。风拂过脸颊，感觉自由。

现在我骑车上学而不是乘公交。它让我健康又开心。

跌倒是学习的一部分。重新站起来才真正重要。
reading.analysis: 含 taught、held、rode 等不规则动词。what really counts 为常用名词性从句，适合进阶句型积累。

reading.title: The Quiet Power of Daily Habits
reading.body:
We often imagine success as a single dramatic moment, yet research suggests it is the quiet sum of small daily habits. The people who thrive are rarely those who act in bursts, but those who repeat modest actions with consistency.

A habit, once wired into the brain, demands far less willpower than a fresh decision. This is why athletes and writers protect their routines so fiercely: the structure does the heavy lifting.

The psychologist B.J. Fogg argues that tiny habits, anchored to existing behaviours, are more durable than grand resolutions. Tying a new action to a cup of morning coffee can quietly reshape a life.

Of course, habits cut both ways. The same automaticity that builds discipline can also entrench distraction, especially in an age of endless notifications.

The lesson is not to chase motivation, which flickers, but to design an environment where the right choice is the easy one. In the end, we are the sum of what we do on the days no one is watching.
reading.zh:
我们常常把成功想象成某个戏剧性的瞬间，然而研究表明，它其实是日常小习惯安静叠加的结果。真正脱颖而出的人，很少是那些爆发式行动的人，而是那些以恒心重复微小行动的人。

习惯一旦嵌入大脑，所需的意志力远少于一次全新的决定。这正是为何运动员和作家如此强烈地保护自己的日常规律：结构替他们承担了重活。

心理学家 B.J. Fogg 认为，锚定在既有行为上的微小习惯，比宏大的决心更持久。把新动作绑定在一杯晨间咖啡上，就能悄然重塑人生。

当然，习惯也有两面性。那种建立自律的自动性，同样可能固化分心，尤其在通知无穷无尽的年代。

教训不在于追逐会闪烁的动机，而在于设计一个环境，让正确的选择成为轻松的选择。归根结底，我们是由无人注视的那些日子里所做之事的总和构成的。
reading.analysis: 使用 yet、rarely...but、cut both ways 等高级衔接与对比结构。词汇如 entrench、automaticity、flicker 地道且书面化，适合进阶学习者积累论证性表达。

reading.title: Why Cities Are Turning to Vertical Forests
reading.body:
As urban populations swell, architects are rethinking the relationship between concrete and greenery. The vertical forest, a building clad in living trees, has moved from concept to skyline in cities from Milan to Nanjing.

Proponents claim these towers filter pollution, lower surface temperatures, and even mute traffic noise. A single facade can host hundreds of species, effectively rebuilding habitat that construction erased.

Yet critics warn the model is energy-hungry and demands constant irrigation. In drier climates, the ecological cost of keeping the plants alive may outweigh the gains.

There is also the question of equity. Green prestige projects can raise surrounding rents, pushing long-term residents outward in a familiar pattern of green gentrification.

The vertical forest is less a silver bullet than a provocative experiment. Its real value may lie in forcing planners to treat nature as infrastructure, not decoration.
reading.zh:
随着城市人口膨胀，建筑师正在重新思考混凝土与绿意之间的关系。垂直森林——一栋覆满活树的建筑——已从概念走进从米兰到南京的天际线。

支持者声称这些塔楼能过滤污染、降低地表温度，甚至削弱交通噪音。单一立面可容纳数百个物种，有效地重建了建设所抹去的栖息地。

然而批评者警告，这种模式耗能巨大且需要持续灌溉。在更干旱的气候中，维持植物存活的生态成本可能超过收益。

还有公平问题。绿色地标项目可能推高周边租金，以熟悉的“绿色绅士化”模式把长期居民向外挤压。

垂直森林与其说是一剂灵丹妙药，不如说是一场发人深省的试验。它真正的价值或许在于迫使规划者把自然当作基础设施，而非装饰。
reading.analysis: 环境科技类报道，含 swell、clad、outweigh、gentrification 等进阶词汇。less...than、not only 等比较与对比句型值得精读仿写。

reading.title: The Lost Art of Boredom
reading.body:
Boredom has acquired a bad name, yet philosophers from Kierkegaard to Heidegger treated it as a doorway to the self. In stillness, the mind finally hears its own quieter questions.

Modern life is engineered to abolish the gap. We fill every pause with a feed, a podcast, a swipe, training our attention into ever-shorter fragments.

Neuroscience offers a clue: the default mode network, active when we do nothing, is where the brain knits memory and meaning. Constant stimulation may starve exactly the process that makes experience coherent.

Children especially need unhurried time. A bored kid is not a failed project but a mind rehearsing its own imagination.

Perhaps the task of maturity is not to escape boredom but to befriend it. In the empty minute lies the raw material of a life examined.
reading.zh:
无聊声名不佳，然而从克尔凯郭尔到海德格尔的哲学家都把它视为通往自我的门。在静止中，心灵终于听见自己更安静的问题。

现代生活被设计成消灭空隙。我们用信息流、播客、滑动填满每个停顿，把注意力训练得越来越碎片化。

神经科学提供了一条线索：当我们无所事事时活跃的“默认模式网络”，正是大脑编织记忆与意义之处。持续的刺激可能恰恰饿死了让经验连贯的过程。

儿童尤其需要从容的时光。一个无聊的孩子不是失败的项目，而是一颗正在排练自己想象力的心灵。

也许成熟的任务不是逃避无聊，而是与之交友。在那空空的片刻里，躺着被审视的人生的原材料。
reading.analysis: 文化思辨类散文，含 abolish、knit、starve、befriend 等生动动词。treat...as、not...but 结构及比喻用法适合进阶写作模仿。

reading.title: How Sleep Shapes Memory
reading.body:
For decades scientists viewed sleep as a passive shutdown, a mere pause in the day's noise. New research paints a far busier picture: the sleeping brain is quietly filing, sorting, and strengthening the day's experiences.

During slow-wave sleep, the hippocampus replays recent events while the cortex integrates them into long-term store. It is less like switching off a computer and more like a nightly librarian.

Dreaming, too, may serve a purpose. By remixing fragments of memory, the brain tests connections it would never try while awake.

Disrupted sleep, by contrast, leaves these files scattered. Studies link poor rest to weaker recall and a higher risk of cognitive decline.

The takeaway is humbling: intelligence is not built only in hours of study but consolidated in hours of rest. To remember well, we must first surrender to sleep.
reading.zh:
几十年来，科学家把睡眠视作被动的关闭，仅仅是白昼喧闹中的暂停。新研究描绘了一幅忙得多的图景：沉睡的大脑正在安静地归档、分类并强化当天的经历。

在慢波睡眠期间，海马体回放近期事件，而皮层把它们整合进长期存储。这不像关掉电脑，更像一位夜班图书管理员。

做梦或许也有目的。通过重新混合记忆碎片，大脑测试那些清醒时绝不会尝试的联结。

相比之下，被打断的睡眠让这些文件散落。研究将糟糕的休息与更弱的记忆力和更高的认知衰退风险联系起来。

结论令人谦卑：智力不只建于学习的数小时，也巩固于休息的数小时。要记得好，我们必须先向睡眠投降。
reading.analysis: 科普说明文，含 file、integrate、consolidate 等精准动词。less like...more like 比较结构与 it is...that 强调句值得学习。

reading.title: The Economics of Free Time
reading.body:
Leisure is often treated as the residue of work, yet its distribution tells a sharper story about inequality than wages alone. The rich increasingly buy time; the poor increasingly sell it.

Time-use surveys reveal a paradox: as societies grow wealthier, self-reported free time barely rises. Convenience technologies save minutes while spawning new demands on attention.

Economists now speak of a time famine, a shortage of unhurried hours that no amount of income seems to cure. The bottleneck is not money but the day's fixed twenty-four hours.

This reframes the debate on well-being. A society that grows GDP while eroding rest may be richer and somehow poorer at once.

Policy, from right-to-disconnect laws to shorter weeks, is beginning to treat time as a resource to be defended. The question is whether productivity can be redefined to include the hours we simply live.
reading.zh:
闲暇常被视为工作之余的残屑，然而它的分配比工资本身更能尖锐地讲述不平等的故事。富人越来越多地购买时间；穷人越来越多地出售时间。

时间使用调查揭示了一个悖论：随着社会变得更富裕，自我报告的自由时间几乎没上升。便利技术省下了分钟，却催生了对注意力的新需求。

经济学家如今谈到“时间饥荒”——一种无论多少收入都似乎治不好的从容时光的短缺。瓶颈不是钱，而是一天固定的二十四小时。

这重新框定了关于福祉的辩论。一个在增长 GDP 的同时侵蚀休息的社会，可能既更富，又在某种意义上是更穷的。

从“断联权”法律到更短工作周，政策正开始把时间当作一种需要捍卫的资源。问题在于生产力能否被重新定义，以纳入我们单纯生活的那些小时。
reading.analysis: 社会经济评论，含 residue、spawn、erode、reframe 等书面动词。yet、while、from...to 等衔接词丰富，适合学习议论文逻辑推进。

reading.title: What Algorithms Get Wrong About Us
reading.body:
Recommendation systems promise to know us better than we know ourselves, yet they flatten the self into a stream of past clicks. The you of tomorrow is assumed to be the you of yesterday.

This creates a feedback loop. The more the algorithm feeds familiar fare, the less exposure we get to the strange and the new that once expanded our taste.

There is also a subtle erasure of context. A late-night search for a gift is read as a lasting desire; a one-off curiosity becomes a permanent profile.

Researchers call this algorithmic determinism, the illusion that behaviour predicts identity. It mistakes a moment for a character.

The remedy is not to abandon personalization but to build systems that leave room for change. A good guide should expect us to surprise it, and to grow.
reading.zh:
推荐系统承诺比我们自己更了解我们，然而它们把自我压扁成过去点击的河流。明天的你被假定为昨天的你。

这制造了一个反馈循环。算法投喂的熟悉内容越多，我们接触到的、曾经拓展品味的陌生与新奇就越少。

还有一种对语境的微妙抹除。深夜为礼物做的一次搜索，被读成持久的欲望；一次性的好奇变成了永久的画像。

研究者称之为“算法决定论”——行为预测身份的错觉。它把瞬间错当成了性格。

解药不是抛弃个性化，而是构建为改变留有余地的系统。好的向导应当预期我们会让它惊讶，并成长。
reading.analysis: 科技评论，含 flatten、erasure、mistake...for 等精准动词。feedback loop、determinism 等术语及 the more...the less 句型适合进阶精读。

reading.title: The Slow Return of the City Centre
reading.body:
After years of suburban flight and remote work, city centres are staging a cautious comeback. The pandemic emptied downtowns, but it also reminded people what they had been missing: chance encounters, shared meals, the texture of a crowd.

Planners are betting on a different kind of density. Rather than offices alone, the revived core mixes homes, schools, and small shops within a short walk.

Transit investment is the quiet engine. Where a reliable train exists, the fifteen-minute neighbourhood becomes plausible rather than utopian.

Still, the revival is uneven. Rising rents threaten to price out the very artists and immigrants who give centres their character.

The lesson of the rebound is modest: cities do not die easily, but they must be re-earned. The centre earns its place by serving daily life, not just skyline ambition.
reading.zh:
在多年的郊区外迁和远程工作之后，城市中心正谨慎地回归。疫情清空了市中心，但也提醒人们他们错过了什么：偶遇、共餐、人群的温度。

规划者押注于一种不同的密度。复兴的核心并非只有办公室，而是在短步范围内混合住宅、学校和小型店铺。

交通投资是安静的引擎。哪里有可靠的火车，十五分钟生活圈就变得可行而非乌托邦。

不过，复兴并不均衡。上涨的租金威胁着把赋予中心特色的艺术家和移民挤出。

反弹的教训是温和的：城市不易消亡，但必须被重新赢回。中心通过服务日常生活、而非仅服务于天际线的野心，来赢得它的位置。
reading.analysis: 社会城市议题，含 flight、revive、plausible、price out 等动词。rather than、where 引导地点从句等结构丰富，适合议论文仿写。

reading.title: The Quiet Crisis of Attention
reading.body:
Attention is the rarest currency of the modern mind, and it is being spent faster than it can be earned. Every app is a tiny lottery, engineered to pay out just often enough to keep us pulling the lever.

The cost is subtle. We do not lose focus in one dramatic break but in a thousand small leaks, each justified as necessary and urgent.

Deep work, the sustained concentration that creates real value, grows rarer as the interface grows louder. What suffers is not only output but the capacity to think long thoughts.

Some are fighting back with blunt tools: phone locks, attention diets, meetings without screens. The aim is to rebuild the muscle that distraction has atrophied.

To protect attention is not nostalgia but survival. A mind that cannot stay with a problem cannot solve it, and cannot truly meet another.
reading.zh:
注意力是现代心智最稀有的货币，而且它正被花得比挣得还快。每个应用都是一台小小的老虎机，被设计成刚好频繁地奖赏，足以让我们一直拉杆。

代价是微妙的。我们并非在一次剧烈的断裂中失去专注，而是在上千个小漏洞中——每一个都被合理地解释为必要且紧急。

深度工作，那种创造真正价值的持续专注，随着界面越来越喧闹而变得稀少。受苦的不只是产出，还有思考长线问题的能力。

有些人在用粗暴的工具反击：手机锁、注意力节食、不开屏幕的会议。目的是重建被分心 atrophy 的肌肉。

保护注意力不是怀旧，而是生存。一个无法停留在问题上的心智，既不能解决它，也无法真正遇见另一个人。
reading.analysis: 以比喻（currency、lottery、leak、muscle）展开论证，含 atrophied、sustained 等词。what suffers is...、not...but 结构适合进阶写作积累。

reading.title: Rethinking the Meaning of Progress
reading.body:
For two centuries progress meant more: more speed, more output, more growth. The graph pointed upward and we called it good, rarely asking who paid the hidden bill.

Climate change has turned that optimism inside out. The same engine of abundance now threatens the systems that abundance depends on, from stable weather to fertile soil.

A quieter model is emerging, one that measures a society by what it preserves as much as what it produces. Well-being, not merely throughput, becomes the metric.

This is not a retreat from ambition but a redirection of it. To build durably is harder, and arguably nobler, than to build fast.

The test of our age may be whether we can keep the gains of modernity while shedding its waste. Progress, redefined, is the art of enough.
reading.zh:
两个世纪以来，进步意味着更多：更快、更多产出、更多增长。曲线向上，我们便称之为好，很少问谁支付了隐藏的账单。

气候变化把那种乐观翻转了过来。同一台丰裕的引擎，如今威胁着丰裕所依赖的系统，从稳定的天气到肥沃的土壤。

一种更安静的模型正在浮现——它既以一个国家生产了什么、也以它 preservation 了什么来衡量社会。福祉，而非仅仅是吞吐量，成为指标。

这不是对雄心的退却，而是对它的重新定向。持久地建造比快速建造更难，也或许更高贵。

我们时代的考验，或许在于能否在保留现代性成果的同时，甩掉它的浪费。被重新定义的进步，是“足够”的艺术。
reading.analysis: 思辨评论，含 throughput、redirection、shed 等词。one that、not...but 及 whether 引导名词从句，论证层层递进，适合仿写。

reading.title: The Science of Friendship
reading.body:
Friendship is often dismissed as a soft subject, yet biology treats it as anything but trivial. Longitudinal studies link strong social ties to longer life, on par with quitting smoking.

The mechanism is partly chemical. Synchronous activity, from laughing to walking, tunes our nervous systems to one another and lowers stress hormones.
